definition:
v. 放弃，抛弃
搭配：abandon a rigid plan
etymology: a-(向外) + bandon(控制) = 解除控制而放弃
sentence_en: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship during the fierce storm.
sentence_zh: 在猛烈的风暴中，船员们不得不弃船逃生。

definition:
v. 废除，取消
搭配：abolish the tax law
etymology: ab-(离开/去除) + ol(生长) = 让其停止生长而废除
sentence_en: Protesters strongly call to abolish the outdated tax law.
sentence_zh: 抗议者强烈呼吁废除这项过时的税法。

definition:
v. 加速，促进
搭配：accelerate economic growth
etymology: ac-(使) + celer(快/速度) = 使速度加快
sentence_en: Global warming has begun to accelerate due to greenhouse gas emissions.
sentence_zh: 由于温室气体排放，全球变暖已经开始加速。

definition:
v. 容纳，向……提供住处，适应
搭配：accommodate diverse needs
etymology: ac-(去) + commod(舒适/便利) = 使变得舒适以容纳
sentence_en: The modern stadium can comfortably accommodate 50,000 spectators.
sentence_zh: 这座现代化体育场可以舒适地容纳5万名观众。

definition:
v. 积累，积聚
搭配：accumulate vast wealth
etymology: ac-(去) + cumul(堆积) = 一点点堆积起来
sentence_en: Dust tends to accumulate rapidly in neglected rooms.
sentence_zh: 在无人打理的房间里，灰尘往往会迅速积聚。

definition:
adj. 精确的，准确无误的
搭配：accurate measurement
etymology: ac-(朝向) + cur(照顾/精确) = 精心照顾而达到精确
sentence_en: Scientists strive to obtain accurate data from every experiment.
sentence_zh: 科学家们努力从每一次实验中获得精确的数据。

definition:
v. 实现，取得，获得
搭配：achieve a breakthrough
etymology: a-(到达) + chief(头领/顶点) = 到达顶点从而实现目标
sentence_en: Hard work is essential if you want to achieve your ultimate goals.
sentence_zh: 如果你想实现最终的目标，努力工作是必不可少的。

definition:
v. 承认，致谢
搭配：acknowledge mistakes
etymology: ac-(加强) + knowledge(知识/认知) = 确认并认知
sentence_en: The politician finally agreed to acknowledge his previous errors.
sentence_zh: 这位政治家最终同意承认他先前的错误。

definition:
v. 获得，取得，学到
搭配：acquire language skills
etymology: ac-(去) + quir(寻求) = 寻求并得到
sentence_en: Children rapidly acquire language skills through natural daily immersion.
sentence_zh: 儿童通过自然的日常沉浸能够迅速获得语言技能。

definition:
v. 适应，改编
搭配：adapt to new environments
etymology: ad-(去) + apt(适合) = 变得适合新环境
sentence_en: Animals must adapt to changing climates to survive.
sentence_zh: 动物必须适应变化的气候才能生存下去。

definition:
adj. 足够的，胜任的
搭配：adequate funding
etymology: ad-(向) + equ(相等/平分) = 刚好够分，数量充足
sentence_en: The school failed to provide adequate medical facilities for students.
sentence_zh: 学校未能为学生提供充足的医疗设施。

definition:
adj. 邻近的，毗邻的
搭配：adjacent buildings
etymology: ad-(靠近) + jac(躺/靠) = 紧紧靠在一起的
sentence_en: They decided to rent two adjacent rooms on the top floor.
sentence_zh: 他们决定在顶楼租下两间相邻的房间。

definition:
v. 调整，调节，适应
搭配：adjust the settings
etymology: ad-(向) + just(精确/正) = 调整到准确状态
sentence_en: You need to adjust the camera lens to get a clearer picture.
sentence_zh: 你需要调整相机镜头以获得更清晰的画面。

definition:
v. 管理，实施，执行
搭配：administer justice
etymology: ad-(去) + minister(仆人/服务) = 像管家一样进行管理
sentence_en: The committee was established to administer university funds.
sentence_zh: 成立该委员会是为了管理大学资金。

definition:
v. 采取，采纳，收养
搭配：adopt a new strategy
etymology: ad-(向) + opt(选择) = 选择并接纳
sentence_en: The enterprise decided to adopt green energy technologies.
sentence_zh: 该企业决定采用绿色能源技术。

definition:
adj. 不利的，有害的，反面的
搭配：adverse effects
etymology: ad-(向) + vers(转) = 朝相反方向转，敌对或不利的
sentence_en: Heavy chemical pollution has severe adverse effects on local ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 重度化学污染对当地生态系统造成了严重的不利影响。

definition:
v./n. 提倡，主张，拥护者
搭配：advocate peace
etymology: ad-(向) + voc(声音/喊) = 站出来大声喊着支持
sentence_en: Environmentalists strongly advocate for wildlife conservation laws.
sentence_zh: 环保主义者强烈主张制定野生动物保护法。

definition:
adj. 美学的，审美的
搭配：aesthetic value
etymology: aesthet(感知) + ic(形容词后缀) = 对感官和美的感知
sentence_en: The historical building possesses exceptional aesthetic and cultural value.
sentence_zh: 这栋历史建筑具有极高的审美和文化价值。

definition:
v./n./adj. 聚集，总计，总数
搭配：aggregate data
etymology: ag-(向) + greg(群体/群) = 聚集到群体里
sentence_en: The aggregate population of these three metropolitan cities is huge.
sentence_zh: 这三个大都市的总人口数量非常庞大。

definition:
v. 分配，拨出（资金、资源等）
搭配：allocate funds
etymology: al-(朝向) + loc(地方) = 拨给各个地方使用
sentence_en: The government decided to allocate more resources to public education.
sentence_zh: 政府决定向公共教育分配更多的资源。

definition:
v. 改变，更改，修改
搭配：alter plans
etymology: alt(其他的) = 变成另一个样子，即改变
sentence_en: Sudden bad weather forced us to alter our travel itinerary.
sentence_zh: 突发的恶劣天气迫使我们改变了旅游行程。

definition:
adj./n. 替代的，两选一的，替代方案
搭配：alternative energy
etymology: alter(其他) + native(属性) = 另一个可选项
sentence_en: Scientists are actively researching clean and sustainable alternative fuels.
sentence_zh: 科学家们正在积极研究清洁且可持续的替代燃料。

definition:
adj. 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
搭配：ambiguous attitude
etymology: ambi-(两边/周围) + ig(走/驱动) = 走在两条路上不知去向，含糊不清
sentence_en: The manager's statement regarding the company's merger was deliberately ambiguous.
sentence_zh: 经理关于公司合并的声明故意说得模棱两可。

definition:
adj. 有雄心的，有抱负的，宏大的
搭配：ambitious project
etymology: ambiti(到处拉选票/野心) + ous = 追求权力和成就的野心
sentence_en: They proposed an ambitious project to explore outer space.
sentence_zh: 他们提出了一项探索外太空的宏伟计划。

definition:
v. 放大，增强，详述
搭配：amplify the sound
etymology: ampl(大/宽) + fy(使...) = 使变大或增强
sentence_en: Microphones are used to amplify speakers' voices in large halls.
sentence_zh: 麦克风用于在大厅里放大演讲者的声音。

definition:
n. 类比，类推，类似
搭配：draw an analogy
etymology: ana-(相似/根据) + log(比例/理性) = 比例相当，进行类比
sentence_en: The professor used a simple mechanical analogy to explain complex physics theories.
sentence_zh: 教授用了一个简单的机械类比来解释复杂的物理理论。

definition:
v. 分析，分解，解析
搭配：analyze experimental data
etymology: ana-(往上/彻底) + lyz(解开/松开) = 把整体解开进行分析
sentence_en: Researchers spent weeks trying to thoroughly analyze the laboratory test results.
sentence_zh: 研究人员花了好几个星期试图彻底分析实验室测试结果。

definition:
n. 祖先，祖宗
搭配：human ancestors
etymology: ante-(在前面) + cest(走/去) = 走在前面的人，即祖先
sentence_en: Archaeologists discovered ancient tools used by our remote human ancestors.
sentence_zh: 考古学家发现了远古人类祖先使用过的古老工具。

definition:
adj./n. 每年的，年度的，年刊
搭配：annual report
etymology: ann(年) + ual(形容词后缀) = 每一年的
sentence_en: The corporation publishes its detailed financial annual report every December.
sentence_zh: 该公司每年十二月都会发布详细的财务年度报告。

definition:
v. 预期，预料，期望
搭配：anticipate future trends
etymology: anti-(在前面) + cip(拿/抓) = 提前拿到，即预料
sentence_en: Experts anticipate a sharp increase in customer demand this holiday season.
sentence_zh: 专家们预计这个假期的客户需求量会急剧增加。

definition:
adj. 焦虑的，担忧的，渴望的
搭配：be anxious about
etymology: anx(压紧/窒息) + ious = 内心紧缩焦虑不安的
sentence_en: Many students feel anxious before major standardized exams.
sentence_zh: 许多学生在重大标准化考试前都会感到焦虑。

definition:
adj. 显然的，表面上的
搭配：it is apparent that
etymology: ap-(向) + par(看见) = 显现出来让人看到的
sentence_en: It became apparent that the initial business plan required complete revision.
sentence_zh: 很显然，最初的商业计划需要全面修改。

definition:
v. 欣赏，感激，增值
搭配：appreciate art
etymology: ap-(去) + preci(价值) = 评估或认识到其价值
sentence_en: Visiting art museums helps people learn to deeply appreciate classic paintings.
sentence_zh: 参观艺术博物馆有助于人们学会深刻欣赏古典名画。

definition:
v./n. 接近，方法，途径
搭配：a practical approach
etymology: ap-(向) + proach(接近/走近) = 走近目标或处理问题的方法
sentence_en: We need to adopt a fresh creative approach to solve this traffic issue.
sentence_zh: 我们需要采用一种全新的创造性方法来解决这个交通问题。

definition:
adj. 适当的，恰当的
搭配：appropriate behavior
etymology: ap-(向) + propri(私有的/恰当的) = 拿来适合自己使用的
sentence_en: Casual clothing is not appropriate for formal business conferences.
sentence_zh: 休闲服装不适合正式的商务会议。

definition:
adj./v. 大约的，近似，接近
搭配：approximate cost
etymology: ap-(向) + proxim(接近) = 尽量靠近的
sentence_en: The approximate distance between the two cities is five hundred miles.
sentence_zh: 这两座城市之间的大约距离是五百英里。

definition:
adj. 任意的，武断的，专制的
搭配：arbitrary decision
etymology: arbitr(仲裁人/主观决断) + ary = 全凭主观任意决定的
sentence_en: The judge criticized the company's arbitrary termination of the employee.
sentence_zh: 法官批评了该公司武断解雇员工的做法。

definition:
n. 建筑师，设计师，缔造者
搭配：chief architect
etymology: archi(主要的) + tect(建造者) = 首席建造师
sentence_en: Le Corbusier is widely recognized as a legendary modern architect.
sentence_zh: 勒·柯布西耶被公认为是一位传奇的现代建筑师。

definition:
v. 出现，发生，起因于
搭配：problems arise
etymology: a-(向上) + rise(升起) = 升起或浮现出来
sentence_en: Various unexpected complications can arise during complex software development.
sentence_zh: 在复杂的软件开发过程中，可能会出现各种意料之外的复杂情况。

definition:
adj. 人工的，人造的，虚假的
搭配：artificial intelligence
etymology: art(手艺/艺术) + fici(做) = 人工做出来的
sentence_en: Modern artificial intelligence is transforming how industries operate globally.
sentence_zh: 现代人工智能正在改变全球各行业的运作方式。

definition:
v. 上升，登高，攀登
搭配：ascend the mountain
etymology: ad-(向上) + scend(爬/攀登) = 往高处爬
sentence_en: The hot air balloon began to slowly ascend into the clear blue sky.
sentence_zh: 热气球开始缓缓上升，飞入蔚蓝的天空。

definition:
n. 方面，外观，方向
搭配：every aspect of life
etymology: ad-(向) + spect(看) = 看问题的某个角度或方面
sentence_en: Digital technology has profoundly influenced every aspect of modern daily life.
sentence_zh: 数字技术深刻影响了现代日常生活方方面面。

definition:
v. 集合，组装，聚集
搭配：assemble components
etymology: ad-(向) + sembl(相同/一起) = 聚集在一块
sentence_en: Workers quickly assemble electronic components inside the automated factory.
sentence_zh: 工人们在自动化工厂里迅速组装电子元器件。

definition:
v. 评估，评定，估价
搭配：assess risks
etymology: ad-(向) + sess(坐下) = 坐在旁边仔细估价或评估
sentence_en: Financial experts must carefully assess market risks before investing funds.
sentence_zh: 金融专家在投资资金前必须仔细评估市场风险。

definition:
n. 资产，宝贵的财富/优点
搭配：valuable asset
etymology: as-(足够) + set(饱足/拥有) = 财产足够且丰厚
sentence_en: Good communication skills are a major asset in any professional career.
sentence_zh: 良好的沟通能力在任何职业生涯中都是一项宝贵的财富。

definition:
v. 分配，指派，指定
搭配：assign homework
etymology: ad-(向) + sign(记号/签字) = 签字盖章指定任务
sentence_en: The manager decided to assign the challenging new task to experienced developers.
sentence_zh: 经理决定把这项具有挑战性的新任务指派给有经验的开发者。

definition:
v. 援助，协助，帮助
搭配：assist research
etymology: ad-(去) + sist(站) = 站在旁边协助
sentence_en: Graduate students often assist professors with scientific laboratory experiments.
sentence_zh: 研究生经常协助教授进行科学实验室实验。

definition:
v./n. 联想，结交，同事
搭配：associate with
etymology: ad-(向) + soci(同伴/社会) = 结为同伴或产生联想
sentence_en: People often mistakenly associate wealth exclusively with personal happiness.
sentence_zh: 人们经常错误地把财富与个人幸福完全划等号。

definition:
v. 假设，承担，假定
搭配：assume responsibility
etymology: ad-(朝向) + sume(拿/取) = 把责任或假设拿过来
sentence_en: We should not blindly assume that the experiment will succeed on the first try.
sentence_zh: 我们不应该盲目假设实验在第一次尝试时就会成功。

definition:
n. 大气层，气氛，空气
搭配：relaxing atmosphere
etymology: atmos(蒸气) + sphere(球体) = 包裹地球的蒸气球体，即大气层
sentence_en: Carbon dioxide concentration in Earth's atmosphere continues to rise steadily.
sentence_zh: 地球大气层中的二氧化碳浓度在稳步持续上升。

definition:
v. 贴上，系上，附属，附上
搭配：attach a file
etymology: at-(去) + tach(钉子/固定) = 用钉子固定在一起
sentence_en: Please remember to attach your resume before sending the application email.
sentence_zh: 在发送申请邮件之前，请记得附上你的简历。

definition:
v./n. 尝试，企图
搭配：attempt to solve
etymology: at-(去) + tempt(尝试/诱惑) = 尝试去做某事
sentence_en: The hacker made several failed attempts to break into the secure mainframe.
sentence_zh: 该黑客数次尝试入侵安全主机均告失败。

definition:
v./n. 归因于，归属于；属性，特征
搭配：attribute success to hard work
etymology: at-(向) + tribut(给予) = 给予归因
sentence_en: The researchers attribute the rapid climate changes primarily to human industrial activities.
sentence_zh: 研究人员将急剧的气候变化主要归因于人类的工业活动。

definition:
adj. 听得见的，清晰可闻的
搭配：barely audible whisper
etymology: aud(听) + ible(能……的) = 能够听到的
sentence_en: The speaker's voice was barely audible over the loud noise of the construction site.
sentence_zh: 由于建筑工地的嘈杂噪音，演讲者的声音几乎听不见。

definition:
adj. 真正的，真实的，地道的
搭配：authentic documents
etymology: authent(有权威的) + ic = 有凭据和权威的，真正的
sentence_en: Experts verified that the antique painting was completely authentic.
sentence_zh: 专家证实这幅古董画完全是真品。

definition:
v. 授权，批准，委托
搭配: authorize a budget
etymology: author(创始人/权威) + ize(使...) = 赋予权力
sentence_en: Only the company director has the legal right to authorize financial expenditures.
sentence_zh: 只有公司董事才拥有批准财务支出的法定权力。

definition:
v. 使自动化，使机械化
搭配：automate production lines
etymology: auto(自动) + mate(使...) = 使自动运行
sentence_en: The factory plans to completely automate its assembly line to increase efficiency.
sentence_zh: 该工厂计划将其装配线完全自动化以提高效率。

definition:
adj./n. 辅助的，备用的；辅助人员
搭配：auxiliary power source
etymology: auxili(帮助) + ary = 提供帮助的
sentence_en: The spacecraft relies on an auxiliary power system during emergencies.
sentence_zh: 航天器在紧急情况下依赖辅助电力系统。

definition:
adj. 可获得的，有空的
搭配：available resources
etymology: a-(加强) + avail(效用/有益) + able = 有用的、可买到的
sentence_en: More detailed reports are available upon request from the research department.
sentence_zh: 向研究部门申请即可获得更详细的报告。

definition:
v. 替……报仇，报复
搭配：avenge a wrong
etymology: a-(去) + venge(惩罚/报复) = 实施报复
sentence_en: In classic literature, heroes often seek to avenge the betrayal of their family.
sentence_zh: 在经典文学中，英雄们经常试图为家人的背叛复仇。

definition:
adj./n./v. 平均的，一般的；平均数
搭配：above average
etymology: avera(海损分摊) + ge = 引申为平均水平
sentence_en: The average daily temperature this summer exceeded previous historical records.
sentence_zh: 今年夏天的平均日气温超过了以往的历史记录。

definition:
n. 航空，航空学，飞机制造业
搭配：civil aviation
etymology: av(鸟) + iation = 像鸟一样飞翔，即航空
sentence_en: Modern civil aviation has connected remote corners of the world closely together.
sentence_zh: 现代民用航空将世界各个偏远角落紧密连接在了一起。

definition:
v. 避免，避开，回避
搭配：avoid mistakes
etymology: a-(离开) + void(空/无效) = 使之落空而避开
sentence_en: Careful planning helps project managers avoid costly mistakes during development.
sentence_zh: 周密的计划有助于项目经理在开发过程中避免代价高昂的错误。

definition:
n. 意识，认识，觉察
搭配：environmental awareness
etymology: aware(知道的) + ness(名词后缀) = 意识
sentence_en: Public awareness of global climate change has increased significantly over the decade.
sentence_zh: 在过去十年中，公众对全球气候变化的意识显著增强。

definition:
adj. 笨拙的，尴尬的，棘手的
搭配：awkward situation
etymology: awk(反向) + ward(朝向) = 朝反方向走，引申为笨拙、别扭
sentence_en: An awkward silence filled the room after the unexpected announcement.
sentence_zh: 突如其来的宣布之后，房间里陷入了一阵尴尬的沉默。

definition:
adj. 贫瘠的，荒凉的，不育的
搭配：barren land
etymology: barr(障碍/封闭) = 无法生长作物的土地
sentence_en: Very few plants can manage to survive in such a harsh, barren desert landscape.
sentence_zh: 极少数植物能在如此严酷、贫瘠的沙漠景观中生存下来。

definition:
n. 障碍物，屏障，关卡
搭配：language barrier
etymology: barr(栅栏) + ier = 设卡拦截的屏障
sentence_en: A language barrier can sometimes complicate international business negotiations.
sentence_zh: 语言障碍有时会使国际商务谈判变得复杂。

definition:
adj. 基本的，基础的
搭配：basic principles
etymology: bas(低/底座) + ic = 处于底座的，基础的
sentence_en: Mastering basic grammar rules is essential for advanced language learners.
sentence_zh: 掌握基本的语法规则对高级语言学习者至关重要。

definition:
n. 代表，为了，利益
搭配：on behalf of
etymology: be-(在...旁边) + half(侧边/利益) = 为了某人的一侧或利益
sentence_en: The lawyer spoke on behalf of her client during the court hearing.
sentence_zh: 在法庭听证会期间，这位律师代表她的客户发言。

definition:
adj. 有益的，有利的
搭配：beneficial effect
etymology: bene(好) + fic(做) = 带来好处的
sentence_en: Regular physical exercise is proven to be highly beneficial to cardiovascular health.
sentence_zh: 规律的体育锻炼被证明对心血管健康非常有益。

definition:
adj. 仁慈的，慈善的
搭配：benevolent fund
etymology: bene(好) + vol(意愿) = 怀有善良意愿的
sentence_en: The local hospital was funded by a wealthy, benevolent philanthropist.
sentence_zh: 当地医院是由一位富有的慈善家资助建立的。

definition:
v. 使迷惑，使不知所措
搭配：bewilder customers
etymology: be-(使...) + wilder(使迷路荒野) = 让人陷入迷惘
sentence_en: Complex technical instructions can often bewilder inexperienced computer users.
sentence_zh: 复杂的说明书常常会把缺乏经验的电脑用户搞糊涂。

definition:
n./v. 偏见，偏爱，使有偏见
搭配：eliminate bias
etymology: bi-(斜) = 斜向一边，即产生偏见
sentence_en: Researchers must work hard to eliminate personal bias from scientific experiments.
sentence_zh: 研究人员必须努力消除科学实验中的个人偏见。

definition:
adj. 奇异的，古怪的
搭配：bizarre behavior
etymology: bizarre(奇特的西班牙雇佣兵形象) = 怪诞的
sentence_en: The witness gave a bizarre account of seeing strange lights in the night sky.
sentence_zh: 目击者对夜空中看到奇异光芒的描述十分古怪。

definition:
v./n. 责备，指责，责任
搭配：take the blame
etymology: blasphem(亵渎/说坏话)演变而来 = 苛责
sentence_en: It is unfair to blame individuals for systemic economic failures.
sentence_zh: 把体制性经济失败归咎于个人是不公平的。

definition:
adj. 清淡的，乏味的，温和的
搭配：bland diet
etymology: bland(平滑/温和) = 味道或情绪温和、缺乏刺激
sentence_en: Patients recovering from surgery are usually advised to eat a bland diet.
sentence_zh: 通常建议术后康复的患者吃清淡的饮食。

definition:
v./n. 开花，繁荣，花朵
搭配：blossom into success
etymology: bloss(开花) = 绽放、茂盛
sentence_en: Cherry trees typically blossom in early spring across the campus.
sentence_zh: 校园里的樱花通常在早春时节盛开。

definition:
v./n. 自夸，夸耀，以拥有……而自豪
搭配：boast rich resources
etymology: boast(吹嘘/夸耀) = 自吹自擂
sentence_en: The university boasts a world-class research laboratory for artificial intelligence.
sentence_zh: 这所大学拥有一个世界级的人工智能研究实验室。

definition:
v./n. 推进，提高，增加
搭配：boost confidence
etymology: boost(向上推) = 提升、推动
sentence_en: New government incentives helped to boost sales in the electric vehicle sector.
sentence_zh: 政府的新激励措施促进了电动汽车行业的销量增长。

definition:
n. 分界线，边界，范围
搭配：national boundary
etymology: bound(界限) + ary = 边界线
sentence_en: Rivers often naturally serve as political boundaries between different countries.
sentence_zh: 河流通常自然地充当不同国家之间的政治边界。

definition:
v./n. 联合抵制，拒绝购买
搭配：boycott the product
etymology: 来自人名 Boycott(英国土地经理因苛刻遭抵制)
sentence_en: Consumers decided to boycott the corporation due to its unfair labor practices.
sentence_zh: 由于该公司的剥削劳工行为，消费者决定联合抵制其产品。

definition:
adj. 灿烂的，杰出的，才华横溢的
搭配：brilliant idea
etymology: brill(闪耀) + iant = 闪闪发光的、聪明的
sentence_en: The young physicist proposed a brilliant solution to the quantum mechanics puzzle.
sentence_zh: 这位年轻的物理学家对量子力学难题提出了一个绝妙的解决方案。

definition:
adj. 残忍的，严酷的，野蛮的
搭配：brutal honesty
etymology: brut(野兽) + al = 像野兽般残忍的
sentence_en: Early explorers had to endure the brutal winter weather in the polar region.
sentence_zh: 早期的探险者不得不忍受极地地区严酷的冬季天气。

definition:
n./v. 预算，编列预算
搭配：annual budget
etymology: bougette(小皮袋/钱袋) = 记账用的皮袋
sentence_en: The engineering team had to reduce expenses to stay within the strict project budget.
sentence_zh: 工程团队不得不削减开支，以维持在严格的项目预算之内。

definition:
n./v. 重担，负担，使承担负担
搭配：financial burden
etymology: bur(搬运) + den(名词后缀) = 扛在身上的重物
sentence_en: High taxation can place a heavy financial burden on small local businesses.
sentence_zh: 高额税收会给当地小企业带来沉重的财务负担。

definition:
v. 计算，推算，核算
搭配：calculate the trajectory
etymology: calcul(小石子) + ate(做...) = 用古罗马小石子计数
sentence_en: Astronomers use advanced computers to calculate the precise orbits of distant asteroids.
sentence_zh: 天文学家使用先进的计算机来计算遥远小行星的精确轨道。

definition:
n./v. 战役，活动，发起运动
搭配：marketing campaign
etymology: camp(旷野/军营) = 原指旷野作战的军事行动
sentence_en: The environmental organization launched a global campaign to reduce plastic waste.
sentence_zh: 该环保组织发起了一场旨在减少塑料垃圾的全球运动。

definition:
n. 候选人，应聘者，申请求职者
搭配：presidential candidate
etymology: candid(白色的) = 古罗马竞选者穿白长袍以示纯洁
sentence_en: Every political candidate must present a clear manifesto before the national election.
sentence_zh: 每个政治候选人都必须在大选前发表清晰的宣言。

definition:
adj. 有能力的，能胜任的
搭配：capable of handling
etymology: cap(拿/容纳) + able = 能够容纳和处理事务的
sentence_en: She proved to be a highly capable manager during the corporate crisis.
sentence_zh: 在公司危机期间，事实证明她是一位极具能力的经理。

definition:
n. 容量，能力，身份
搭配：storage capacity
etymology: cap(拿/装) + acity(名词后缀) = 容纳的大小
sentence_en: The new hard drive offers an enormous storage capacity for high-definition video files.
sentence_zh: 这款新硬盘为高清视频文件提供了巨大的存储容量。

definition:
v./n. 捕获，俘获，夺得
搭配：capture data
etymology: capt(抓) + ure = 抓住不放
sentence_en: Sensors are designed to capture real-time meteorological changes instantly.
sentence_zh: 传感器旨在即时捕获实时的气象变化。

definition:
n. 碳，碳元素
搭配：carbon emission
etymology: carb(炭) + on = 化学元素碳
sentence_en: Governments worldwide are implementing strict regulations to lower carbon emissions.
sentence_zh: 世界各国政府都在实施严格的法规以降低碳排放。

definition:
adj. 休闲的，偶然的，随意的
搭配：casual attire
etymology: cas(发生/落下) + ual = 偶然碰上的，非正式的
sentence_en: The company allows employees to wear casual clothing on Friday afternoons.
sentence_zh: 该公司允许员工在周五下午穿休闲服装。

definition:
n. 催化剂，促进因素
搭配：catalyst for change
etymology: cata-(向下/完全) + lys(解开) = 加速反应的催化剂
sentence_en: The technological innovation acted as a major catalyst for economic restructuring.
sentence_zh: 技术创新充当了经济结构调整的重要催化剂。

definition:
n. 种类，类别，范畴
搭配：fall into the category
etymology: cata-(向下) + agor(公开集市/宣告) = 归入哪个宣告大类中
sentence_en: Books in the university library are sorted neatly into specific academic categories.
sentence_zh: 大学图书馆里的书籍被整齐地归类到特定的学术类别中。

definition:
adj. 谨慎的，小心的
搭配：cautious approach
etymology: caut(小心/注意) + ious = 满怀戒备和小心谨慎的
sentence_en: Investors remain extremely cautious regarding volatile cryptocurrency markets.
sentence_zh: 投资者对动荡的加密货币市场保持高度谨慎。

definition:
v./n. 停止，终了，中止
搭配：cease fire
etymology: ceas(停止/走完) = 停止不再继续
sentence_en: Opposing military forces finally agreed to sign a permanent cease-fire treaty.
sentence_zh: 敌对军事力量最终同意签署一项永久停火条约。

definition:
adj. 著名的，驰名的，受赞誉的
搭配：celebrated novelist
etymology: celebr(频繁/隆重) + ated = 经众人隆重庆祝的，出名的
sentence_en: The celebrated author gave a captivating lecture on modern European literature.
sentence_zh: 这位著名作家就现代欧洲文学发表了一场迷人的演讲。

definition:
adj. 天体的，天空的，天堂的
搭配：celestial bodies
etymology: coel(天空) + estial = 天上的，星体的
sentence_en: Ancient astronomers tracked the regular movements of celestial bodies across the night sky.
sentence_zh: 古代天文学家追踪天体在夜空中的规律运动。

definition:
v./n. 审查，检查（出版物等）；审查员
搭配：censor information
etymology: cens(评估/判断) = 罗马负责统计和监督道德的官员
sentence_en: Certain oppressive regimes attempt to strictly censor independent news broadcasts.
sentence_zh: 某些压迫性政权试图严格审查独立新闻广播。

definition:
v. 集中，实行中央集权
搭配：centralize power
etymology: center(中心) + ize(使...) = 汇聚到中心
sentence_en: The corporation decided to centralize its administrative management in the headquarters.
sentence_zh: 该公司决定将行政管理集中在总部。

definition:
v. 证明，证实，发证书给
搭配：certified documents
etymology: cert(确定的) + fy(使...) = 使确凿并证明
sentence_en: An independent inspection agency must certify the safety standards of aircraft engines.
sentence_zh: 独立的检验机构必须证明飞机发动机的安全标准。

definition:
n. 锦标赛，冠军称号，维护
搭配：win the championship
etymology: champion(冠军) + ship(资格/状态) = 冠军头衔
sentence_en: The national basketball team fought hard to win the international championship.
sentence_zh: 国家篮球队奋力拼搏，赢得了国际锦标赛冠军。

definition:
n. 混乱，紊乱，混浊状态
搭配：utter chaos
etymology: chaos(宇宙大爆炸前的巨大空洞或混乱状态)
sentence_en: A sudden power outage threw the entire international airport terminal into chaos.
sentence_zh: 突如其来的停电使整个国际机场航站楼陷入了混乱。

definition:
adj./n. 特有的，典型的；特征，特性
搭配：unique characteristic
etymology: character(性格/印记) + istic = 具有标志性的特征
sentence_en: Adaptability to cold climates is a primary characteristic of arctic mammals.
sentence_zh: 适应寒冷气候是北极哺乳动物的主要特征。

definition:
v. 描绘……的特性，具有……的特征
搭配：be characterized by
etymology: character(特征) + ize(使...) = 刻画特征
sentence_en: Modern industrial growth is often characterized by rapid technological advancement.
sentence_zh: 现代工业增长通常以技术迅速进步为特征。

definition:
adj. 慈善的，宽容的
搭配：charitable donation
etymology: charit(慈爱) + able = 充满慈爱和慈善的
sentence_en: The wealthy entrepreneur made a generous charitable donation to the local hospital.
sentence_zh: 这位富有的企业家向当地医院慷慨捐赠了慈善资金。

definition:
v. 珍爱，怀有（希望、感情等），抚育
搭配：cherish the memory
etymology: cher(亲爱的) + ish(动词后缀) = 视若珍宝
sentence_en: We should always cherish the wonderful memories of our school days.
sentence_zh: 我们应当永远珍藏学生时代的美好回忆。

definition:
adj. 慢性的，长期的，惯常的
搭配：chronic illness
etymology: chron(时间) + ic = 延续很长时间的慢性病
sentence_en: Polluted air in urban areas can contribute to chronic respiratory diseases.
sentence_zh: 城市地区的污染空气会导致慢性的呼吸系统疾病。

definition:
adj. 按时间顺序排列的
搭配：chronological order
etymology: chron(时间) + log(科学/记录) + ical = 按时间先后记录的
sentence_en: Historical events in the textbook are presented in strict chronological order.
sentence_zh: 教科书中的历史事件是按严格的时间顺序呈现的。

definition:
n. 电路，环行，巡回
搭配：integrated circuit
etymology: circ(圆/环) + it(走) = 绕一圈的回路
sentence_en: A microchip consists of millions of microscopic electronic circuits.
sentence_zh: 微芯片由数百万个微型电子电路组成。

definition:
v. 循环，流通，发行，传播
搭配：circulate air
etymology: circul(圆圈) + ate(使...) = 使转圈流动
sentence_en: Ventilation systems are required to properly circulate fresh air inside buildings.
sentence_zh: 建筑物内需要通风系统来顺畅流通新鲜空气。

definition:
n. 环境，条件，情况，境遇
搭配：under no circumstances
etymology: circum(周围) + stance(站立) = 周围站立的客观情况
sentence_en: Under no circumstances should sensitive security passwords be shared with others.
sentence_zh: 任何情况下都不应将机密的密码与他人分享。

definition:
v. 引用，引证，表彰
搭配：cite evidence
etymology: cit(唤起/召唤) = 召唤原文作为证据
sentence_en: The academic paper must properly cite all external research sources used.
sentence_zh: 学术论文必须正确引用所有使用外部研究来源。

definition:
n. 文明，文化，文明社会
搭配：ancient civilization
etymology: civil(公民/城市) + ization(名词后缀) = 城市化及人类文明
sentence_en: Archaeologists study ruins to uncover the secrets of ancient river valley civilizations.
sentence_zh: 考古学家通过研究废墟来揭开古代河流山谷文明的秘密。

definition:
v. 澄清，阐明，使清澈
搭配：clarify a point
etymology: clar(清楚/清澈) + fy(使...) = 使变得清楚
sentence_en: The professor paused during the lecture to clarify a complex theoretical point.
sentence_zh: 教授在讲课期间停顿了一下，以阐明一个复杂的理论要点。

definition:
adj./n. 经典的，古典的；名著，经典作品
搭配：classic literature
etymology: class(班级/等级) + ic = 高等级的、一流名著
sentence_en: Shakespeare's plays remain timeless classic works studied by students globally.
sentence_zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧依然是全球学生学习的永恒经典之作。

definition:
v. 分类，归类，分级
搭配：classify data
etymology: class(类别) + fy(使...) = 划分成各种类别
sentence_en: Libraries use specific catalog systems to classify books by subject matter.
sentence_zh: 图书馆使用特定的目录系统按主题对书籍进行分类。

definition:
n. 客户，顾客，委托人
搭配：serve a client
etymology: cli(倾斜/依靠) + ent = 依附于律师或商人的顾客
sentence_en: Lawyers must maintain strict confidentiality regarding all information shared by a client.
sentence_zh: 律师必须对客户分享的所有信息严格保密。

definition:
n. 气候，风气，思潮
搭配：global climate change
etymology: clim(倾斜) = 地球纬度倾斜导致的气候带
sentence_en: Global climate change poses severe threats to fragile coastal ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 全球气候变化对脆弱的海岸生态系统构成了严峻威胁。

definition:
n./v. 串，群，丛；成群聚集
搭配：cluster of stars
etymology: clot(凝结)的变体 = 密集的一团
sentence_en: Astronomers discovered a brilliant cluster of stars shining in the distant galaxy.
sentence_zh: 天文学家在遥远的星系中发现了一个闪闪发光的星团。

definition:
adj. 粗糙的，粗鲁的，劣质的
搭配：coarse fabric
etymology: coarse(粗劣未加工的)
sentence_en: The workers wore thick gloves made of coarse material to protect their hands.
sentence_zh: 工人们戴着用粗糙材料制成厚手套来保护双手。

definition:
adj. 认知的，认识的
搭配：cognitive development
etymology: cogn(知道) + itive = 与大脑认知思维相关的
sentence_en: Early childhood education plays a vital role in fostering healthy cognitive development.
sentence_zh: 幼儿教育在培育健康的认知发展方面起着至关重要的作用。

definition:
adj. 连贯的，一致的，条理清晰的
搭配：coherent argument
etymology: co-(共同) + her(粘在一起) = 粘连紧密、条理清晰
sentence_en: The researcher presented a coherent and persuasive argument during the seminar.
sentence_zh: 研究人员在研讨会上发表了一个连贯且极具说服力的论点。

definition:
v. 合作，协作，通敌
搭配：collaborate on a project
etymology: col-(共同) + labor(劳动) = 共同劳动合作
sentence_en: Scientists from different countries frequently collaborate on large space missions.
sentence_zh: 来自不同国家的科学家经常在大型太空任务中进行合作。

definition:
v./n. 倒塌，崩溃，瓦解
搭配：economic collapse
etymology: col-(加强) + lapse(滑落/跌倒) = 整体坍塌滑落
sentence_en: The severe financial crisis led to the sudden collapse of several major banks.
sentence_zh: 严重的金融危机导致了几家主要银行的突然崩溃。

definition:
n. 同事，同僚
搭配：work with a colleague
etymology: col-(共同) + leagu(捆绑/选择) = 共同共事的人
sentence_en: She discussed her new research findings with a close colleague at the office.
sentence_zh: 她在办公室里与一位亲密的同事讨论了她的新研究成果。

definition:
v. 殖民，拓荒，群居（生物学）
搭配：colonize new lands
etymology: colon(农庄/移民) + ize = 建立殖民地
sentence_en: European nations sought to colonize vast territories across the globe during past centuries.
sentence_zh: 在过去的几个世纪里，欧洲国家试图在全球范围内开辟殖民地。

definition:
n. 专栏，圆柱，纵队
搭配：newspaper column
etymology: column(柱子/直立结构)
sentence_en: The famous economist writes a weekly opinion column for the national newspaper.
sentence_zh: 这位著名的经济学家为全国性报纸撰写每周的观点专栏。

definition:
v./n. 格斗，战斗，反对
搭配：combat inflation
etymology: com-(共同) + bat(打) = 相互搏斗反对
sentence_en: Central banks use strict monetary policies to combat runaway inflation.
sentence_zh: 中央银行使用紧缩的货币政策来对抗失控的通货膨胀。

definition:
v./n. 联合，结合，化合
搭配：combine forces
etymology: com-(共同) + bin(两倍/成对) = 把两部分结合在一起
sentence_en: The two companies decided to combine their resources to create a stronger enterprise.
sentence_zh: 这两家公司决定合并资源，打造一家更强大的企业。

definition:
v. 开始，着手
搭配：commence operations
etymology: com-(完全) + init(开始) = 正式开始启动
sentence_en: The construction project is scheduled to commence early next Monday morning.
sentence_zh: 该建筑项目预定于下周一清晨正式开工。

definition:
v. 称赞，表扬，推荐
搭配：commend bravery
etymology: com-(加强) + mand(托付/交托) = 托付赞赏
sentence_en: The local police chief rose to commend the young citizen for his exceptional bravery.
sentence_zh: 当地警察局长起身表扬这位年轻公民的非凡勇敢。

definition:
n. 实况报道，评论，评注
搭配：political commentary
etymology: comment(评论) + ary = 连续的评论和讲解
sentence_en: The television broadcast provided detailed live commentary during the athletic match.
sentence_zh: 电视转播在运动比赛期间提供了详细的现场实况解说。

definition:
n. 商业，贸易
搭配：electronic commerce
etymology: com-(共同) + merc(货物/买卖) = 共同做买卖
sentence_en: Global electronic commerce has grown exponentially over the past decade.
sentence_zh: 在过去十年中，全球电子商务呈指数级增长。

definition:
n./v. 委员会，佣金，授权委托
搭配：investigation commission
etymology: com-(共同) + miss(送/派) = 委派出去的委员会
sentence_en: An independent investigation commission was established to review the accident.
sentence_zh: 成立了一个独立的调查委员会来审查这起事故。

definition:
v. 犯（罪），承诺，把……交托给
搭配：commit a crime
etymology: com-(加强) + mit(送) = 送去办坏事或完全交付
sentence_en: Severe economic hardship can sometimes drive desperate individuals to commit crimes.
sentence_zh: 严重的经济困顿有时会驱使绝望的人去犯罪。

definition:
n. 商品，日用品，有价值的物资
搭配：commodity market
etymology: commod(便利/合适) = 可以拿来买卖便利的物品
sentence_en: Crude oil remains one of the most heavily traded commodities in global financial markets.
sentence_zh: 原油仍然是全球金融市场交易量最大的大宗商品之一。

definition:
adj. 共同的，普通的，平常的
搭配：common goal
etymology: com-(共同) + mun(服务/公共) = 大家共同拥有的
sentence_en: Team members worked closely together to achieve a common strategic goal.
sentence_zh: 团队成员紧密合作，以实现共同的战略目标。

definition:
v. 沟通，交流，传达
搭配：communicate effectively
etymology: commun(公共/分享) + ate = 彼此分享信息，即沟通
sentence_en: Modern digital tools make it remarkably easy to communicate across vast distances.
sentence_zh: 现代数字工具使得跨越巨大距离的沟通变得极其容易。

definition:
n. 社区，共同体，群体
搭配：local community
etymology: commun(公共) + ity = 公共群体，即社区
sentence_en: Volunteers organized a clean-up campaign to improve the safety of the local community.
sentence_zh: 志愿者们组织了一场清洁活动，以改善当地社区的安全环境。

definition:
adj./v./n. 紧凑的，小型的；压实；契约
搭配：compact design
etymology: com-(加强) + pact(压紧) = 压紧挤密
sentence_en: The modern electric vehicle features a compact design suitable for crowded cities.
sentence_zh: 这款现代电动汽车采用适合拥挤城市的小型紧凑设计。

definition:
n. 同伴，伴侣，共事者
搭配：travel companion
etymology: com-(共同) + pan(面包) = 一起吃面包的人，即同伴
sentence_en: Dogs have long been considered loyal and faithful companions to humans.
sentence_zh: 长期以来，狗一直被认为是人类忠实可靠的伴侣。

definition:
adj. 可比较的，类似的
搭配：comparable results
etymology: compar(比较) + able = 能够拿来对比的
sentence_en: The two scientific experiments yielded remarkably comparable results.
sentence_zh: 这两项科学实验取得了非常具有可比性的结果。

definition:
v. 补偿，赔偿，抵消
搭配：compensate for losses
etymology: com-(加强) + pens(称重量/付钱) = 称平砝码进行补偿
sentence_en: Insurance companies must compensate homeowners fully for property damages.
sentence_zh: 保险公司必须对房主的财产损失给予充分赔偿。

definition:
adj. 有能力的，能胜任的，称职的
搭配：competent authority
etymology: com-(共同) + pet(追求/竞争) = 有能力在竞争中胜出的
sentence_en: Only competent technicians are authorized to repair complex electrical machinery.
sentence_zh: 只有称职的技术人员才有权修理复杂的电气机械。

definition:
v. 汇编，编纂，编译（代码）
搭配：compile data
etymology: com-(共同) + pil(掠夺/堆积) = 收集并堆积在一起编纂
sentence_en: Researchers spent months trying to compile comprehensive statistical data reports.
sentence_zh: 研究人员花了好几个月试图汇编全面的统计数据报告。

definition:
n./v. 补足物，配套；补充
搭配：perfect complement
etymology: complet(填满) = 能够让整体圆满的补充部分
sentence_en: Theory and practical laboratory work serve as a perfect complement to each other.
sentence_zh: 理论和实际的实验室工作相互之间构成了完美的补充。

definition:
adj./n. 复杂的，复合的；建筑群，综合体
搭配：complex problem
etymology: com-(共同) + plex(编织) = 盘根错节交织在一起的
sentence_en: Resolving international climate change policies involves addressing deeply complex issues.
sentence_zh: 解决国际气候变化政策涉及处理极其复杂的问题。

definition:
v. 遵守，顺从，服从
搭配：comply with regulations
etymology: com-(完全) + ply(折叠/顺从) = 完全顺从照办
sentence_en: All manufacturing plants must strictly comply with national environmental protection laws.
sentence_zh: 所有制造厂都必须严格遵守国家环境保护法。

definition:
n. 成分，零部件，组件
搭配：electronic component
etymology: com-(共同) + pon(放置) = 组合放置在一起的零部件
sentence_en: Semiconductors are a critical electronic component used in modern computers.
sentence_zh: 半导体是现代计算机中不可或缺的关键电子组件。

definition:
v. 组成，作曲，撰写
搭配：compose music
etymology: com-(共同) + pos(放置) = 拼合放置在一起组合
sentence_en: Various mineral elements combine to compose the complex structure of rocks.
sentence_zh: 各种矿物元素结合在一起构成了岩石复杂的结构。

definition:
v. 理解，领悟，包含
搭配：comprehend the meaning
etymology: com-(加强) + prehend(抓住) = 脑子完全抓住了要领，即理解
sentence_en: It is difficult for young students to fully comprehend advanced quantum physics theories.
sentence_zh: 年轻学生很难完全理解高级量子物理学理论。

definition:
adj. 全面的，广泛的，综合的
搭配：comprehensive guide
etymology: comprehend(理解/包括) + ive = 包罗万象、全面的
sentence_en: The university library provides a comprehensive collection of academic journals.
sentence_zh: 大学图书馆提供了一系列全面的学术期刊收藏。

definition:
n./v. 妥协，折中，危及
搭配：reach a compromise
etymology: com-(共同) + promise(承诺) = 双方互作承诺以达成妥协
sentence_en: Both negotiating parties were willing to make concessions to reach a fair compromise.
sentence_zh: 谈判双方都愿意做出让步以达成公平的妥协。

definition:
v. 计算，估算，推算
搭配：compute results
etymology: com-(共同) + put(算账/思考) = 一起计算核算
sentence_en: Supercomputers can compute billions of complex mathematical operations per second.
sentence_zh: 超级计算机每秒可以计算数以十亿计的复杂数学运算。

definition:
v. 隐藏，隐瞒，掩盖
搭配：conceal information
etymology: con-(加强) + ceal(藏) = 彻底藏起来
sentence_en: The suspect tried desperately to conceal evidence from the investigative officers.
sentence_zh: 犯罪嫌疑人拼命试图向调查人员隐瞒证据。

definition:
v. 承认，退让，让步
搭配：concede defeat
etymology: con-(加强) + cede(走/退让) = 甘愿退让或承认
sentence_en: The political candidate finally decided to concede defeat after trailing in votes.
sentence_zh: 这位政治候选人在票数落后后，最终决定承认失败。

definition:
v. 构想，设想，怀孕
搭配：conceive an idea
etymology: con-(加强) + ceiv(拿/抓) = 脑海中孕育构想
sentence_en: Engineers first had to conceive a new blueprint before building the vehicle.
sentence_zh: 工程师在制造车辆之前，必须首先构想出一个新的蓝图。

definition:
v./n. 集中，专心，浓缩物
搭配：concentrate on studies
etymology: con-(共同) + centr(中心) = 集中到中心
sentence_en: Students need a quiet environment to concentrate effectively on difficult academic tasks.
sentence_zh: 学生需要一个安静的环境来集中精力完成困难的学术任务。

definition:
n. 概念，观念，设想
搭配：abstract concept
etymology: con-(加强) + cept(抓/拿) = 脑中抓住了的概念
sentence_en: Mastering abstract mathematical concepts requires patience and continuous practice.
sentence_zh: 掌握抽象的数学概念需要耐心和不断练习。

definition:
v./n. 涉及，关心，担忧
搭配：express concern
etymology: con-(共同) + cern(筛分/关注) = 卷入其中并表示关切
sentence_en: Environmental degradation has become a matter of grave global concern.
sentence_zh: 环境恶化已成为全球严重关切的问题。

definition:
adj. 齐心协力的，一致的
搭配：concerted effort
etymology: con-(共同) + cert(安排/商定) = 共同协商完成的
sentence_en: A concerted international effort is vital to address global carbon emission issues.
sentence_zh: 齐心协力的国际努力对于应对全球碳排放问题至关重要。

definition:
n. 让步，妥协，特许权
搭配：tax concession
etymology: concede的名词形式 = 让步与妥协
sentence_en: The local government offered generous tax concessions to attract foreign tech companies.
sentence_zh: 当地政府提供了优厚的税收优惠以吸引外国科技公司。

definition:
adj. 简明的，简洁的
搭配：concise summary
etymology: con-(加强) + cis(切) = 切除冗余部分，保持简洁
sentence_en: Please provide a clear and concise summary of your research methodology.
sentence_zh: 请提供一份清晰简洁的研究方法总结。

definition:
v. 推断出，结束，达成
搭配：conclude a deal
etymology: con-(完全) + clud(关闭) = 彻底关闭、得出结论
sentence_en: Scientists can safely conclude that the experiment was successful based on data.
sentence_zh: 科学家根据数据可以确信该实验取得了成功。

definition:
adj./n. 具体的，有形的；混凝土
搭配：concrete evidence
etymology: con-(共同) + cret(生长/凝结) = 凝结在一起的固体或具体事物
sentence_en: Investigators must present concrete evidence before filing formal criminal charges.
sentence_zh: 调查人员在提起正式刑事指控之前必须出示具体的证据。

definition:
v. 谴责，判刑，声讨
搭配：condemn violence
etymology: con-(加强) + demn(损害/罚款) = 严厉宣告有罪或谴责
sentence_en: World leaders were quick to strongly condemn the acts of international terrorism.
sentence_zh: 世界各国领导人迅速强烈谴责国际恐怖主义行径。

definition:
v. 凝结，浓缩，简述
搭配：condense steam
etymology: con-(加强) + dense(密集的) = 使变得更为紧密浓缩
sentence_en: Cool air causes water vapor to condense into tiny droplets of morning dew.
sentence_zh: 凉爽的空气导致水蒸气凝结成清晨的微小露珠。

definition:
n./v. 条件，状况，环境；使适应
搭配：working condition
etymology: con-(共同) + dic(说/约定) = 共同约定的条件
sentence_en: Factory workers protested to demand better and safer working conditions.
sentence_zh: 工厂工人抗议，要求改善和保障更安全的工作条件。

definition:
v./n. 组织，实施，引导；行为品行
搭配：conduct research
etymology: con-(加强) + duct(引导) = 引导并实施
sentence_en: University professors regularly conduct professional scientific research experiments.
sentence_zh: 大学教授定期进行专业的科学研究实验。

definition:
v. 协商，商讨，授予（称号、学位）
搭配：confer a degree
etymology: con-(共同) + fer(带来) = 共同拿来商量或授予
sentence_en: The university committee will meet tomorrow to confer honorary academic degrees.
sentence_zh: 大学委员会将于明天开会，授予名誉学术学位。

definition:
v. 坦白，承认，忏悔
搭配：confess a mistake
etymology: con-(完全) + fess(说) = 毫无保留地招认
sentence_en: The suspect chose to confess his crimes during the police interrogation.
sentence_zh: 嫌疑人在警方审讯期间选择坦白了他的罪行。

definition:
adj. 自信的，确信的
搭配：be confident of success
etymology: con-(完全) + fid(信任) = 深信不疑、充满自信
sentence_en: The research team is highly confident of achieving positive experimental outcomes.
sentence_zh: 研究团队对取得积极的实验结果充满信心。

definition:
v./n. 限制，禁闭；边界
搭配：confine within limits
etymology: con-(共同) + fin(边界) = 限制在边界之内
sentence_en: Researchers tried to confine the infection within a controlled laboratory space.
sentence_zh: 研究人员试图将感染限制在受控的实验室空间内。

definition:
v. 确认，证实，批准
搭配：confirm a reservation
etymology: con-(加强) + firm(坚固/坚定) = 使之更加坚定确认
sentence_en: New laboratory test results help to confirm the validity of the initial hypothesis.
sentence_zh: 新的实验室测试结果有助于证实最初假设的有效性。

definition:
n./v. 冲突，矛盾，争执
搭配：armed conflict
etymology: con-(共同) + flict(打击) = 互相打击冲突
sentence_en: Diplomats strive to resolve international political conflicts through peaceful negotiations.
sentence_zh: 外交官们努力通过和平谈判解决国际政治冲突。

definition:
v. 遵守，符合，相一致
搭配：conform to standards
etymology: con-(共同) + form(形状) = 形状相同、符合标准
sentence_en: All building designs must strictly conform to local safety and zoning regulations.
sentence_zh: 所有建筑设计都必须严格符合当地的安全和分区规定。

definition:
v. 面对，遭遇，对抗
搭配：confront difficulties
etymology: con-(面对) + front(额头/前面) = 正面迎击
sentence_en: Entrepreneurs must learn to bravely confront unexpected business risks and challenges.
sentence_zh: 企业家必须学会勇敢面对意想不到的商业风险和挑战。

definition:
v. 使混乱，使迷惑，混淆
搭配：confuse concepts
etymology: con-(共同) + fus(流淌/倾倒) = 把不同的液体混在一起，即混淆
sentence_en: Similar technical terms can easily confuse beginners learning programming languages.
sentence_zh: 相似的技术术语很容易使学习编程语言的新手感到迷惑。

definition:
adj. 拥挤的，堵塞的
搭配：congested traffic
etymology: con-(加强) + gest(带来/积聚) = 堆积过密、交通拥堵
sentence_en: Commuters often experience delays when traveling through congested downtown streets.
sentence_zh: 通勤者在穿过拥挤的闹市区街道时经常遇到延误。

definition:
v. 祝贺，向……道喜
搭配：congratulate on success
etymology: con-(共同) + grat(高兴/感谢) = 共同分享喜悦
sentence_en: The professor stepped forward to warmly congratulate the students on their graduation.
sentence_zh: 教授走上前去，热烈祝贺学生们顺利毕业。

definition:
n. 代表大会，国会，议会
搭配：members of Congress
etymology: con-(共同) + gress(走) = 走到一起开会
sentence_en: The national Congress voted to approve the new fiscal budget bill.
sentence_zh: 全国代表大会投票通过了新的财政预算案。

definition:
n. 结合，连接，连词（语法）
搭配：in conjunction with
etymology: con-(共同) + junct(连接) = 连结在一起
sentence_en: The two research institutions worked in conjunction to develop the vaccine.
sentence_zh: 这两家研究机构联合协作开发了该疫苗。

definition:
v. 连接，联结，联系
搭配：connect to the internet
etymology: con-(共同) + nect(结/绑) = 捆绑连结在一起
sentence_en: High-speed broadband cables help connect residential homes to global networks.
sentence_zh: 高速宽带电缆有助于将住宅连接到全球网络。

definition:
v. 征服，克服，战胜
搭配：conquer difficulties
etymology: con-(完全) + quer(寻求/获取) = 彻底攻克占领
sentence_en: Mountaineers showed remarkable courage trying to conquer the icy peak.
sentence_zh: 登山者们表现出非凡的勇气，试图征服这座冰峰。

definition:
n. 良心，道德心
搭配：clear conscience
etymology: con-(共同) + sci(知道) = 内心明辨是非的良知
sentence_en: He acted with a clear conscience, knowing he did everything he could to help.
sentence_zh: 他凭着良心做事，知道自己已经尽了一切努力去帮忙。

definition:
adj. 意识到的，有知觉的，刻意的
搭配：be conscious of
etymology: con-(共同) + sci(知道) + ous = 具有清晰认知的
sentence_en: The injured patient remained fully conscious while waiting for medical assistance.
sentence_zh: 受伤的病人在等待医疗援助期间保持完全清醒。

definition:
adj. 连续的，连贯的
搭配：consecutive days
etymology: con-(跟随) + secut(跟随) = 一个接一个连续不断的
sentence_en: The local region experienced heavy rainfall for five consecutive days.
sentence_zh: 当地经历了连续五天的强降雨。

definition:
n. 一致意见，共识
搭配：reach a consensus
etymology: con-(共同) + sens(感觉) = 大家感觉一致的共识
sentence_en: After hours of heated debate, the board finally reached a consensus on the proposal.
sentence_zh: 经过几个小时的热烈辩论，董事会终于就该提案达成了共识。

definition:
n. 结果，后果，重要性
搭配：face the consequences
etymology: con-(跟随) + sequ(跟随) = 事情随之而来的结果
sentence_en: Individuals must be prepared to face the legal consequences of their actions.
sentence_zh: 个人必须准备好承担其行为带来的法律后果。

definition:
n. 保存，保护（自然资源等）
搭配：energy conservation
etymology: con-(完全) + serv(保存/服务) = 保护与维持
sentence_en: Wildlife conservation programs play a crucial role in protecting endangered species.
sentence_zh: 野生动物保护项目在保护濒危物种方面起着至关重要的作用。

definition:
adj. 相当大的，相当多的，可观的
搭配：considerable amount
etymology: consider(考虑) + able = 值得考虑的、数量可观的
sentence_en: Implementing the new software system required a considerable investment of time and money.
sentence_zh: 实施新的软件系统需要投入大量的时间和资金。

definition:
v. 由……组成，在于，符合
搭配：consist of
etymology: con-(共同) + sist(站立) = 各部分站在一起组成整体
sentence_en: A balanced diet should consist of various nutritious food groups.
sentence_zh: 均衡的饮食应当由各种营养丰富的食物组成。

definition:
adj. 一致的，连贯的，始终如一的
搭配：consistent performance
etymology: con-(共同) + sist(站) = 站位始终如一、保持一致
sentence_en: The athlete maintained consistent training habits to prepare for the championship.
sentence_zh: 这位运动员保持着始终如一的训练习惯，为锦标赛做准备。

definition:
v. 巩固，加强，联合，合并
搭配：consolidate power
etymology: con-(加强) + solid(坚固的) = 使变得坚固稳固
sentence_en: The victorious company moved quickly to consolidate its leading market position.
sentence_zh: 这家获胜的公司迅速采取行动，巩固其领先的市场地位。

definition:
adj. 显眼的，明显的，引人注目的
搭配：conspicuous success
etymology: con-(加强) + spic(看) = 极其显眼、让人一眼看到
sentence_en: The bright yellow sign made the warning message extremely conspicuous to drivers.
sentence_zh: 亮黄色的标志使得警告信息对司机来说极其显眼。

definition:
adj./n. 持续不断的，恒定的；常数
搭配：constant pressure
etymology: con-(持续) + stant(站立) = 稳固站立、永恒不变的
sentence_en: Submarine explorers had to endure constant pressure in deep ocean waters.
sentence_zh: 潜水探险者在深海洋水中必须忍受持续不断的水压。

definition:
v. 构成，组成，设立
搭配：constitute a threat
etymology: con-(共同) + stitut(建立) = 建立并组成整体
sentence_en: Nitrogen and oxygen together constitute the vast majority of Earth's atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 氮和氧共同构成了地球大气层的绝大部分。

definition:
n. 约束，限制，严管
搭配：budget constraint
etymology: con-(加强) + strain(拉紧/束缚) = 束缚限制
sentence_en: Strict financial constraints forced the research team to scale down their experiments.
sentence_zh: 严格的财务限制迫使研究团队缩小了实验规模。

definition:
v./n. 建造，建设，构筑；构想
搭配：construct a building
etymology: con-(共同) + struct(建造) = 搭建建造
sentence_en: Engineers plan to construct a modern bridge across the wide river valley.
sentence_zh: 工程师计划在宽阔的河谷上建造一座现代化的桥梁。

definition:
v. 请教，咨询，查阅
搭配：consult a doctor
etymology: con-(共同) + sult(商议) = 坐在一起共同商议求教
sentence_en: Patients should always consult a qualified medical professional before taking new medicine.
sentence_zh: 患者在服用新药之前，务必咨询合格的医疗专业人员。

definition:
v. 消耗，消费，吃完
搭配：consume energy
etymology: con-(完全) + sum(拿/用) = 完全用光吃光
sentence_en: Industrial factories tend to consume massive amounts of electrical power daily.
sentence_zh: 工业工厂每天往往消耗大量的电力能源。

definition:
n./v. 接触，联系，交往
搭配：keep in contact
etymology: con-(共同) + tact(接触) = 彼此互相接触
sentence_en: Digital messaging applications make it convenient to stay in contact with overseas friends.
sentence_zh: 数字即时通讯应用使得与海外朋友保持联系变得十分方便。

definition:
v. 包含，容纳，克制
搭配：contain costs
etymology: con-(完全) + tain(拿/握) = 完全拿在手里容纳
sentence_en: Seawater contains various dissolved mineral salts and organic elements.
sentence_zh: 海水包含各种溶解的矿物盐和有机元素。

definition:
adj./n. 当代的，现代的；同时代的人
搭配：contemporary art
etymology: con-(共同) + tempor(时间) + ary = 处于同一时代或当代的
sentence_en: The museum exhibits an impressive collection of contemporary abstract paintings.
sentence_zh: 博物馆展出了大量令人印象深刻的当代抽象画作。

definition:
v. 竞争，争夺，声称
搭配：contend for the title
etymology: con-(共同) + tend(用力/伸展) = 奋力竞争争夺
sentence_en: Several talented athletes will contend for the championship title this weekend.
sentence_zh: 几位优秀的运动员将在本周末争夺冠军头衔。

definition:
n./adj. 内容，目录，满足的
搭配：table of contents
etymology: con-(完全) + tent(容纳) = 容纳在内部的东西，即内容
sentence_en: The academic book includes a detailed table of contents at the beginning.
sentence_zh: 这本学术书在开头包含了一个详细的目录。

definition:
n. 上下文，语境，背景
搭配：in this context
etymology: con-(共同) + text(织物/文本) = 编织在一起的前后语境
sentence_en: Translators must consider the cultural context when interpreting foreign idioms.
sentence_zh: 译者在诠释外国习语时必须考虑其文化背景。

definition:
n. 大陆，洲
搭配：African continent
etymology: con-(共同) + tin(保持/容纳) = 连成一片的大陆片区
sentence_en: Tectonic plate movements caused the separation of ancient supercontinents over epochs.
sentence_zh: 板块构造运动导致古代超级大陆在各个地质时期发生分离。

definition:
adj. 频繁的，连续不断的（中间有间隔）
搭配：continual interruptions
etymology: continue(继续) + ual = 一次次持续不断的
sentence_en: The ongoing construction project caused continual noise disturbances in the neighborhood.
sentence_zh: 持续不断的建筑工程在社区里造成了频繁的噪音干扰。

definition:
n./v. 合同，契约；收缩，感染
搭配：sign a contract
etymology: con-(共同) + tract(拉) = 拉拢在一起订立契约或缩小
sentence_en: Both employer and employee must sign a formal legal employment contract.
sentence_zh: 雇主和雇员都必须签署正式的法律雇用合同。

definition:
v. 反驳，同……矛盾，抵触
搭配：contradict a statement
etymology: contra-(相反) + dict(说) = 唱反调反驳
sentence_en: New scientific evidence appears to directly contradict the researcher's previous theories.
sentence_zh: 新的科学证据似乎与研究人员先前的理论直接相矛盾。

definition:
adj./n. 相反的，对抗的；相反意见
搭配：on the contrary
etymology: contr(相反) + ary = 对立相反的
sentence_en: The economic outcome was quite contrary to what financial experts had predicted.
sentence_zh: 经济结果与金融专家的预测完全相反。

definition:
n./v. 对比，对照，差异
搭配：in contrast with
etymology: contra-(相反) + st(站立) = 站立在对面进行对比
sentence_en: The sharp contrast between urban and rural living standards is worth studying.
sentence_zh: 城乡生活水平之间的巨大差异值得研究。

definition:
v. 贡献，捐献，促成
搭配：contribute to success
etymology: con-(共同) + tribut(给予) = 共同出一份力贡献
sentence_en: Many dedicated volunteers worked together to contribute to the community project.
sentence_zh: 许多奉献的志愿者齐心协力为社区项目做出贡献。

definition:
adj. 有争议的，引起争论的
搭配：controversial issue
etymology: controversy(争论) + ial = 充满争议的
sentence_en: Artificial intelligence ethics has become a highly controversial topic among scholars.
sentence_zh: 人工智能伦理已经成为学者们中间一个极具争议的话题。

definition:
adj. 便利的，方便的，近便的
搭配：convenient location
etymology: con-(共同) + ven(来) = 大家都汇聚得很方便
sentence_en: Online shopping offers a convenient way for consumers to buy daily necessities.
sentence_zh: 网上购物为消费者购买日常生活用品提供了一种便捷的方式。

definition:
n. 会议，惯例，常规，公约
搭配：international convention
etymology: con-(共同) + vent(来) = 人聚集开会或约定俗成的惯例
sentence_en: Scientists from across the globe gathered to attend the annual climate convention.
sentence_zh: 来自全球各地的科学家汇聚一堂，参加年度气候大会。

definition:
v./n. 转变，转化，皈依者
搭配：convert energy
etymology: con-(彻底) + vert(转) = 彻底转变方向
sentence_en: Solar panels are designed to efficiently convert sunlight into electrical energy.
sentence_zh: 太阳能电池板旨在高效地将阳光转化为电能。

definition:
v. 表达，传递（思想、信息等），运送
搭配：convey a message
etymology: con-(加强) + vey(路/运送) = 沿着道路运送或传递信息
sentence_en: Artistic masterpieces often convey profound philosophical insights about human existence.
sentence_zh: 艺术杰作通常传达出关于人类生存的深刻哲学见解。

definition:
v. 说服，使确信，使信服
搭配：convince the jury
etymology: con-(完全) + vinc(征服/胜利) = 用道理彻底征服对方
sentence_en: The lawyer worked hard to convince the jury of her client's complete innocence.
sentence_zh: 律师努力说服陪审团相信她的客户完全无辜。

definition:
v. 合作，配合，协作
搭配：cooperate with others
etymology: co-(共同) + oper(工作) = 共同工作合作
sentence_en: Different departments must cooperate closely to ensure smooth project execution.
sentence_zh: 不同部门必须紧密合作，以确保项目顺利执行。

definition:
v./n. 协调，配合；坐标
搭配：coordinate actions
etymology: co-(共同) + ordin(顺序/等级) = 调整秩序使之协调
sentence_en: Project managers must carefully coordinate activities across multiple teams.
sentence_zh: 项目经理必须仔细协调多个团队之间的各项活动。

definition:
adj. 热诚的，亲切的，诚挚的
搭配：cordial welcome
etymology: cord(心脏) + ial = 发自内心的热诚
sentence_en: The international delegation received a cordial and warm welcome upon arrival.
sentence_zh: 国际代表团抵达时受到了热烈而亲切的欢迎。

definition:
adj. 公司的，法人的，社团的
搭配：corporate culture
etymology: corpor(身体/团体) + ate = 组成法团公司的
sentence_en: Maintaining a healthy corporate culture helps attract and retain top talent.
sentence_zh: 保持健康的宏观公司文化有助于吸引和留住顶尖人才。

definition:
v./n. 关联，使有相互关系
搭配：correlate data
etymology: cor-(共同) + relate(关联) = 相互关联
sentence_en: Scientists tried to correlate rising global temperatures with greenhouse gas emissions.
sentence_zh: 科学家试图将不断上升的全球气温与温室气体排放联系起来。

definition:
v. 相符合，相当，通信
搭配：correspond with reality
etymology: cor-(共同) + respond(回应) = 彼此呼应、相符合
sentence_en: The physical evidence found at the crime scene does not correspond with the suspect's story.
sentence_zh: 在犯罪现场发现的物证与嫌疑人的说辞不相符。

definition:
v. 腐蚀，侵蚀，损毁
搭配：corrode metal
etymology: cor-(加强) + rod(咬/啃) = 像虫子一样慢慢啃咬腐蚀
sentence_en: Acid rain can gradually corrode metal structures and damage historical stone monuments.
sentence_zh: 酸雨会逐渐腐蚀金属结构并破坏历史石制纪念碑。

definition:
adj. 宇宙的，广大无垠的
搭配：cosmic rays
etymology: cosm(宇宙/秩序) + ic = 宇宙的
sentence_en: High-energy cosmic rays constantly bombard the upper layers of Earth's atmosphere.
sentence_zh: 高能宇宙射线不断轰击地球大气层的高层。

definition:
n. 理事会，委员会，地方议会
搭配：city council
etymology: counse(召集/商议) = 聚在一起商议的理事会
sentence_en: The local city council approved a new plan to expand public park spaces.
sentence_zh: 当地市议会批准了一项扩大公共公园空间的新计划。

definition:
n./v. 劝告，建议，法律顾问
搭配：legal counsel
etymology: counsel(建议/商讨)
sentence_en: The accused individual sought professional legal counsel before speaking to investigators.
sentence_zh: 被指控的个人在与调查人员谈话前寻求了专业的法律顾问意见。

definition:
n. 相对应的人或物，配对物
搭配：foreign counterpart
etymology: counter(相对) + part(部分) = 职位或功能对应的另一方
sentence_en: The minister met with his foreign counterpart to discuss bilateral trade agreements.
sentence_zh: 这位部长会见了其外国同行，以讨论双边贸易协定。

definition:
n. 礼貌，谦恭，客气话
搭配：common courtesy
etymology: cour(宫廷) + tesy = 宫廷般的礼貌气度
sentence_en: Basic professional courtesy requires returning business emails within twenty-four hours.
sentence_zh: 基本的职业礼貌要求在24小时内回复商务邮件。

definition:
adj. 创造性的，有创意的
搭配：creative thinking
etymology: creat(创造) + ive = 充满创造力的
sentence_en: Advertising campaigns rely heavily on creative thinking and original design concepts.
sentence_zh: 广告活动严重依赖创造性思维和原创设计概念。

definition:
adj. 可信的，可靠的
搭配：credible evidence
etymology: cred(相信) + ible = 能够让人相信的
sentence_en: Investigators must find credible evidence to support their claims in court.
sentence_zh: 调查人员必须找到可信的证据来支持他们在法庭上的主张。

definition:
n. 标准，准则，尺度
搭配：selection criterion
etymology: criter(标准/判断) = 用于评判的标准
sentence_en: Academic excellence is a primary selection criterion for university scholarship awards.
sentence_zh: 学业优异是大学奖学金评选的主要标准。

definition:
adj. 至关重要的，决定性的
搭配：crucial role
etymology: cruc(十字路口) = 站在十字路口做抉择，至关重要
sentence_en: Timely data collection plays a crucial role in ensuring accurate scientific conclusions.
sentence_zh: 及时的死数据收集在确保准确的科学结论方面起着至关重要的作用。

definition:
adj. 神秘的，含义模糊的，隐藏的
搭配：cryptic message
etymology: crypt(秘密/地下室) + ic = 隐藏神祕的
sentence_en: The programmer left a cryptic note inside the source code comments before resigning.
sentence_zh: 程序员在辞职前在源代码注释中留下了一条神秘的便签。

definition:
v. 达到顶点，告终，克终大成
搭配：culminate in success
etymology: culmin(顶点/屋顶) + ate = 到达最高点
sentence_en: Years of rigorous scientific research eventually culminated in a major medical breakthrough.
sentence_zh: 多年的严谨科学研究最终在一个重大医学突破中达到顶峰。

definition:
v. 耕种，培育，培养（习惯、能力等）
搭配：cultivate habit
etymology: cult(耕种/栽培) + ivate = 精心耕作栽培
sentence_en: Good teachers try to cultivate independent critical thinking skills in their students.
sentence_zh: 优秀的老师试图在学生中培养独立的批判性思维能力。

definition:
adj. 累积的，渐增的
搭配：cumulative effect
etymology: cumul(堆积) + ative = 一点点堆积起来的
sentence_en: Industrial pollution has a cumulative negative impact on local aquatic ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 工业污染对当地水生生态系统具有累积的负面影响。

definition:
n. 好奇心，求知欲，罕见珍品
搭配：scientific curiosity
etymology: curi(关心/注意) + osity = 充满探究的好奇心
sentence_en: Children possess a natural curiosity to explore how the physical world operates.
sentence_zh: 儿童具有探索物理世界如何运作的天然好奇心。

definition:
n. 课程，课程体系
搭配：school curriculum
etymology: curr(跑/赛跑道) + iculum = 学习跑道，即课程大纲
sentence_en: The university updated its computer science curriculum to include modern AI modules.
sentence_zh: 该大学更新了计算机科学课程体系，纳入了现代人工智能模块。

definition:
adj. 合乎习俗的，惯常的
搭配：customary practice
etymology: custom(风俗习惯) + ary = 符合惯例的
sentence_en: It is customary in many cultures to exchange gifts during festive holidays.
sentence_zh: 在许多文化中，在节日期间互赠礼物是惯例。

definition:
adj. 小巧精致的，讲究的，挑剔的
搭配：dainty steps
etymology: dign(价值/高贵)的变体 = 精致娇美的
sentence_en: The tea set was decorated with intricate patterns and dainty porcelain handles.
sentence_zh: 这套茶具装饰着复杂的图案和精致的瓷质手柄。

definition:
v./n. 炫目，耀眼，使倾倒
搭配：dazzling light
etymology: daze(眩晕/发呆)的衍生 = 耀眼夺目
sentence_en: The night sky was filled with a dazzling display of bright stars.
sentence_zh: 夜空中闪烁着耀眼的繁星。

definition:
n./v. 僵局，僵持，死锁（计算机）
搭配：reach a deadlock
etymology: dead(死) + lock(锁) = 锁死无法动弹的僵局
sentence_en: Labor negotiations reached a complete deadlock after hours of disagreement.
sentence_zh: 在数小时的分歧之后，劳资谈判陷入了彻底的僵局。

definition:
n./v. 辩论，争论，讨论
搭配：public debate
etymology: de-(加强) + bat(打) = 激烈争辩辩论
sentence_en: Lawmakers engaged in a lengthy public debate regarding the new tax reform policy.
sentence_zh: 立法者就新的税制改革政策展开了长时间的公开辩论。

definition:
n. 碎片，残骸，瓦砾堆
搭配：space debris
etymology: de-(去掉) + bris(破裂) = 破碎后剩下的残骸碎片
sentence_en: Satellites in orbit face increasing risks from floating space debris.
sentence_zh: 轨道上的卫星面临着来自漂浮太空残骸的日益增加的风险。

definition:
n./v. 初次登台，首次亮相
搭配：make a debut
etymology: de-(从) + but(尽头/跨出第一步) = 首次登台亮相
sentence_en: The young pianist made a stunning debut at the national concert hall.
sentence_zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在国家音乐厅进行了惊艳的首次亮相。

definition:
v./n. 腐烂，衰退，衰落
搭配：urban decay
etymology: de-(向下) + cad(落下) = 向下掉落腐败衰落
sentence_en: Organic materials naturally decay over time when exposed to moisture and air.
sentence_zh: 有机物质在暴露于水分和空气中时，随着时间推移会自然腐烂。

definition:
v. 欺骗，哄骗，蒙蔽
搭配：deceive customers
etymology: de-(向下/向旁) + ceiv(拿) = 把人带入歧途进行欺骗
sentence_en: Dishonest advertisers often attempt to deceive consumers with exaggerated product claims.
sentence_zh: 不诚实的广告商经常试图用夸大的产品宣传来欺骗消费者。

definition:
v. 破译，解释，辨认（密码或古文字）
搭配：decipher a code
etymology: de-(去除/相反) + cipher(密码/数字) = 把密码还原破解
sentence_en: Cryptographers spent years trying to decipher the complex wartime communication codes.
sentence_zh: 密码专家花了好几年时间试图破译复杂的战时通讯密码。

definition:
v./n. 下降，衰退，婉言谢绝
搭配：decline an invitation
etymology: de-(向下) + clin(倾斜) = 向下倾斜衰退
sentence_en: Many wildlife habitats face continuous decline due to rapid urban expansion.
sentence_zh: 由于城市迅速扩张，许多野生动物栖息地面临不断衰退。

definition:
v. 装饰，装潢，授勋
搭配：decorate the room
etymology: decor(美丽/体面) + ate = 使变得美丽优雅
sentence_en: Families traditionally gather to decorate their homes with lights for the holidays.
sentence_zh: 家庭传统上会聚集在一起，用彩灯装饰房屋以庆祝节日。

definition:
v./n. 减少，减小，降低
搭配：decrease rapidly
etymology: de-(向下) + crease(生长/变大) = 长的趋势向下，即减少
sentence_en: Energy-saving technologies help to significantly decrease electricity consumption in homes.
sentence_zh: 节能技术有助于显著减少家庭的电力消耗。

definition:
v. 奉献，致力于，献身于
搭配：dedicate time to research
etymology: de-(加强) + dicat(宣告/奉献) = 庄严宣告并奉献
sentence_en: She decided to dedicate her entire academic career to cancer research.
sentence_zh: 她决定将自己的整个学术生涯奉献给癌症研究。

definition:
v. 推论，推断，演绎
搭配：deduce from evidence
etymology: de-(向下/从) + duc(引导) = 从已知线索中引导出结论
sentence_en: Detectives can deduce the sequence of events from footprints left at the scene.
sentence_zh: 侦探可以从现场留下的脚印推断出事件的经过。

definition:
v. 防御，保护，辩护
搭配：defend rights
etymology: de-(向下/抵抗) + fend(打击) = 抵挡打击保护
sentence_en: Lawyers work diligently to defend the constitutional rights of their clients.
sentence_zh: 律师们勤勉工作，以捍卫其客户的宪法权利。

definition:
n. 缺乏，不足，缺点，缺陷
搭配：vitamin deficiency
etymology: de-(向下/缺) + fici(做/达到) = 达不到要求，即缺乏
sentence_en: A strict diet lacking fresh vegetables can lead to severe nutritional deficiency.
sentence_zh: 缺乏新鲜蔬菜的严格节食会导致严重的营养不良。

definition:
v. 定义，阐明，规定
搭配：define the scope
etymology: de-(加强) + fin(界限/边界) = 划清界限并定义
sentence_en: Researchers must clearly define their key research variables before starting experiments.
sentence_zh: 研究人员在开始实验前必须清楚定义其核心研究变量。

definition:
adv. 肯定地，确切地
搭配：definitely agree
etymology: definite(确定的) + ly = 毫无疑问地
sentence_en: Advanced renewable energy technologies will definitely shape our environmental future.
sentence_zh: 先进的可再生能源技术必将塑造我们的环境未来。

definition:
v. 偏转，使转向，避开（问题等）
搭配：deflect criticism
etymology: de-(偏离) + flect(弯曲) = 弯曲偏转方向
sentence_en: The politician skillfully used jokes to deflect sharp questions from reporters.
sentence_zh: 这位政治家巧妙地用笑话来避开记者尖锐的提问。

definition:
v. 降解，使退化，侮辱
搭配：degrade the environment
etymology: de-(向下) + grad(级别/台阶) = 降到更低的级别或退化
sentence_en: Certain plastic materials take centuries to naturally degrade in landfills.
sentence_zh: 某些塑料材料在垃圾填埋场中需要数百年才能自然降解。

definition:
n./v. 代表；委派，授权
搭配：delegate tasks
etymology: de-(向下) + leg(派遣/法律) = 委派代表出去
sentence_en: Effective leaders know how to appropriately delegate responsibilities to team members.
sentence_zh: 高效的领导者懂得如何适当地将责任委派给团队成员。

definition:
adj./v. 故意的，深思熟虑的；仔细商讨
搭配：deliberate attempt
etymology: de-(加强) + liber(天平/秤) = 放在天平上反复斟酌的
sentence_en: The corporate executive made a deliberate decision to expand into global markets.
sentence_zh: 这位企业高管做出了向全球市场扩张的深思熟虑决定。

definition:
adj. 微妙的，脆弱的，精美的
搭配：delicate balance
etymology: delic(诱人/精美) + ate = 精致脆弱的
sentence_en: Marine biologists study the delicate balance of coral reef ecosystems.
sentence_zh: 海洋生物学家研究珊瑚礁生态系统的微妙平衡。

definition:
n./v. 高兴，快乐，使高兴
搭配：to one's delight
etymology: de-(加强) + laci(诱惑/高兴) = 带来极大的快乐
sentence_en: The magnificent fireworks display brought immense delight to the young children.
sentence_zh: 壮丽的烟花表演给小孩子们带来了极大的快乐。

definition:
v. 递送，交付，发表（演讲等）
搭配：deliver a speech
etymology: de-(向下/出) + liver(自由) = 解救或送货交付
sentence_en: The keynote speaker delivered an inspiring lecture on technological innovation.
sentence_zh: 主题演讲者发表了一场关于技术创新的鼓舞人心的演讲。

definition:
v. 迷惑，哄骗，自欺欺人
搭配：delude oneself
etymology: de-(向下/向旁) + lud(玩耍/戏弄) = 戏弄玩弄别人
sentence_en: Investors should not delude themselves into believing high profits come without risk.
sentence_zh: 投资者不应自欺欺人地认为高利润会伴随零风险。

definition:
n. 民主，民主制，民主国家
搭配：protect democracy
etymology: demo(人民) + cracy(统治) = 人民当家作主
sentence_en: Freedom of speech remains a fundamental pillar of modern western democracy.
sentence_zh: 言论自由仍然是现代西方民主制度的基本支柱。

definition:
v. 拆毁，拆除，推翻，破坏
搭配：demolish buildings
etymology: de-(向下/彻底) + mol(磨坊/石块) = 把建筑彻底砸毁拆除
sentence_en: City authorities plan to demolish the outdated stadium to build a modern park.
sentence_zh: 城市当局计划拆除这座过时的体育场以建设一个现代化的公园。

definition:
v. 证明，展示，示范，游行示威
搭配：demonstrate skills
etymology: de-(完全) + monstr(显示) = 完全展示证明出来
sentence_en: The laboratory experiment successfully helped to demonstrate the physical law.
sentence_zh: 实验室实验成功地帮助证明了这一物理定律。

definition:
adj. 密集的，稠密的，浓厚的
搭配：dense forest
etymology: dens(厚实紧密的)
sentence_en: Morning fog grew so dense that drivers could only see a few meters ahead.
sentence_zh: 早晨的浓雾变得如此厚重，以至于司机只能看清前方几米。

definition:
v. 否定，否认，拒绝提供
搭配：deny allegations
etymology: de-(相反) + ny(说) = 说相反的话来否认
sentence_en: The official chose to strongly deny all allegations of financial corruption.
sentence_zh: 这位官员选择强烈否认所有关于财务腐败的指控。

definition:
v. 离开，出发，背离
搭配：depart from routine
etymology: de-(离开) + part(部分/分开) = 从此地分离离开
sentence_en: The express train is scheduled to depart precisely at eight o'clock morning.
sentence_zh: 快车预定于早晨八点整准时出发。

definition:
n. 部门，系，科
搭配：department store
etymology: depart(分开) + ment = 分开的独立部门或大学系科
sentence_en: The university's computer science department attracts thousands of applicants yearly.
sentence_zh: 该大学的计算机科学系每年吸引数千名申请者。

definition:
v. 依靠，依赖，取决于
搭配：depend on results
etymology: de-(向下) + pend(悬挂) = 挂在上面依附着
sentence_en: Ecological survival in polar regions often depends heavily on seasonal weather cycles.
sentence_zh: 极地地区的生态生存往往很大程度上取决于季节性天气循环。

definition:
v. 描绘，描述，刻画
搭配：depict a scene
etymology: de-(加强) + pict(画/画相) = 用画笔或文字描绘
sentence_en: Classic novels often vividly depict the harsh social realities of their historical eras.
sentence_zh: 经典小说常常生动地描绘其历史时期严酷的社会现实。

definition:
v./n. 存放，沉淀，押金，存款
搭配：bank deposit
etymology: de-(向下) + posit(放置) = 放置存放在地下或银行里
sentence_en: Rivers slowly deposit layers of rich silt along their lower delta plains.
sentence_zh: 河流在其下游三角洲平原沿线慢慢沉积一层层肥沃的淤泥。

definition:
v. 使沮丧，使萧条，压下
搭配：depress wages
etymology: de-(向下) + press(压) = 向下压，即压抑或经济萧条
sentence_en: Surplus agricultural production can sometimes severely depress market prices.
sentence_zh: 农业过剩有时会严重压低市场价格。

definition:
v. 剥夺，使失去
搭配：deprive of rights
etymology: de-(去除) + priv(私人的/剥夺) = 剥夺应得的私人物品
sentence_en: Extreme poverty can unfortunately deprive children of proper educational opportunities.
sentence_zh: 极端贫困不幸地剥夺了儿童获得适当教育机会的权利。

definition:
v. 取得，衍生出，源自
搭配：derive from
etymology: de-(从) + riv(河流) = 从源头引水，引申为源于
sentence_en: Many English scientific terminology words derive directly from ancient Greek roots.
sentence_zh: 许多英语科学术语直接源自古希腊语词根。

definition:
v. 下降，下倾，传承
搭配：descend the stairs
etymology: de-(向下) + scend(爬/走) = 往下走
sentence_en: The hiking expedition began to carefully descend the steep mountain path.
sentence_zh: 徒步远征队开始小心翼翼地下陡峭的山路。

definition:
v. 值得，应得
搭配：deserve praise
etymology: de-(加强) + serv(服务/应得) = 理应得到服务和回报
sentence_en: Dedicated volunteers who work tirelessly for the community truly deserve special recognition.
sentence_zh: 为社区辛勤工作的不倦志愿者确实应当获得特别表彰。

definition:
v./adj. 指定，标明，指派；指定的
搭配：designated area
etymology: de-(加强) + sign(记号) = 做上记号指定
sentence_en: Smoking is strictly prohibited outside designated public smoking areas.
sentence_zh: 在指定的公共吸烟区之外，严禁吸烟。

definition:
adj. 值得向往的，称心的，合意的
搭配：highly desirable
etymology: desire(渴望) + able = 令人渴望的
sentence_en: Fluency in at least two foreign languages is a highly desirable career qualification.
sentence_zh: 精通至少两门外语是一项非常令人向往的职业资格。

definition:
adj. 荒凉的，无人烟的，孤寂的
搭配：desolate landscape
etymology: de-(完全) + sol(单独/荒凉) = 极其荒凉孤寂
sentence_en: The lonely traveler crossed a vast and desolate stretch of rocky desert.
sentence_zh: 孤独的旅行者穿过了一片广袤而荒凉的岩石沙漠。

definition:
v. 鄙视，看不起，厌恶
搭配：despise dishonesty
etymology: de-(向下) + spis(看) = 向下看不起，即鄙视
sentence_en: Honest people typically despise dishonesty and deceitful business practices.
sentence_zh: 诚实的人通常鄙视不诚实和欺骗性的商业行为。

definition:
n. 目的地，终点，预定目标
搭配：popular tourist destination
etymology: destin(决定/命运) + ation = 注定要去的目的地
sentence_en: After hours of flying, the passenger aircraft finally landed at its destination.
sentence_zh: 经过数小时的飞行，客机终于降落在目的地。

definition:
adj. 贫困的，赤贫的，穷困潦倒的
搭配：destitute families
etymology: de-(去除) + stitu(设立/拥有) = 什么财产都没有的赤贫者
sentence_en: Charitable organizations provide food and shelter for destitute homeless people.
sentence_zh: 慈善组织为赤贫的无家可归者提供食物和住所。

definition:
v. 破坏，毁灭，消灭
搭配：destroy habitats
etymology: de-(向下/破坏) + stroy(建造) = 把建造的东西拆毁破坏
sentence_en: Wildfires can quickly destroy vast forests and local residential communities.
sentence_zh: 野火能迅速毁灭广袤的森林和当地的居民社区。

definition:
v. 分开，拆卸，使分离
搭配：detach a component
etymology: de-(分离) + tach(钉子/固定) = 把固定的东西拆卸分开
sentence_en: Users can easily detach the digital keyboard from the portable tablet computer.
sentence_zh: 用户可以轻松地将数字键盘从便携式平板电脑上拆卸下来。

definition:
v. 察觉，发现，侦测出
搭配：detect anomalies
etymology: de-(去除) + tect(覆盖/屋顶) = 揭开屋顶发现秘密
sentence_en: Sensitive monitoring sensors can detect tiny atmospheric temperature fluctuations.
sentence_zh: 敏感的监控传感器可以侦测到微小的大气温度波动。

definition:
v. 恶化，变坏，退化
搭配：deteriorate rapidly
etymology: de-(向下) + terior(更坏的) = 状况越来越坏
sentence_en: Patient health conditions can rapidly deteriorate without proper medical treatment.
sentence_zh: 如果没有适当的医疗处理，病人的健康状况可能会迅速恶化。

definition:
v. 决定，确定，测定
搭配：determine the cause
etymology: de-(完全) + termin(边界/终点) = 划定终点、彻底决定
sentence_en: Engineers conducted rigorous tests to determine the exact cause of engine failure.
sentence_zh: 工程师进行了严格的测试，以确定发动机故障的确切原因。

definition:
v. 毁灭，使荒废，使极度悲痛
搭配：devastate a city
etymology: de-(彻底) + vast(荒凉/空旷) = 使彻底变成一片废墟
sentence_en: Powerful hurricanes can easily devastate coastal towns within a few hours.
sentence_zh: 强烈的飓风能在几个小时内轻松摧毁沿海城镇。

definition:
v. 背离，偏离，出轨
搭配：deviate from the plan
etymology: de-(偏离) + via(道路) = 偏离正常道路
sentence_en: Automated aircraft must not deviate from their programmed flight paths.
sentence_zh: 自动驾驶飞机绝不能偏离其预设的飞行航线。

definition:
n. 装置，设备，诡计
搭配：electronic device
etymology: de- + vis(划分/设计) = 精心设计出来的装置
sentence_en: Smartphone users carry a powerful computing device in their pockets daily.
sentence_zh: 智能手机用户每天在口袋里随身携带一台强大的计算设备。

definition:
v. 奉献，致力于，把……专用于
搭配：devote time to
etymology: de-(向下) + vot(发誓) = 发誓效忠奉献
sentence_en: Successful researchers typically devote long hours to precise experimentation.
sentence_zh: 成功的研究人员通常会投入大量时间进行精确的实验。

definition:
v. 诊断（疾病），判断（问题）
搭配：diagnose an illness
etymology: dia-(穿过/彻底) + gnos(知道) = 彻底了解并诊断
sentence_en: Modern medical scanning equipment helps doctors accurately diagnose internal diseases.
sentence_zh: 现代医疗扫描设备帮助医生准确诊断内部疾病。

definition:
n. 方言，土语，地方话
搭配：local dialect
etymology: dia-(在...之间) + lect(说话) = 不同地区人说的话，即方言
sentence_en: Visitors traveling in remote rural regions might struggle to understand the local dialect.
sentence_zh: 在偏远农村地区旅行的游客可能会很难听懂当地的方言。

definition:
v./n. 口授，命令，支配，指令
搭配：dictate terms
etymology: dict(说话/命令) + ate = 说了算、下达口令
sentence_en: Market supply and demand naturally dictate the prices of consumer goods.
sentence_zh: 市场供求关系自然地决定了消费品的價格。

definition:
n./v. 饮食，日常食物，节食
搭配：balanced diet
etymology: dieta(生活方式/饮食规定)
sentence_en: Maintaining a balanced diet rich in vitamins is essential for physical health.
sentence_zh: 保持富含维生素的均衡饮食对身体健康至关重要。

definition:
v. 不同，相异，有意见分歧
搭配：differ in opinion
etymology: dis-(分离) + fer(携带/走) = 各走各的路、存在差异
sentence_en: Scholars may sometimes differ significantly regarding historical interpretations.
sentence_zh: 学者们在历史阐释方面有时可能会存在显著的分歧。

definition:
v. 区分，区别，使不同
搭配：differentiate between
etymology: different(不同的) + iate = 使彼此产生差异并区分
sentence_en: Infants gradually learn to differentiate between familiar and unfamiliar faces.
sentence_zh: 婴儿逐渐学会区分熟悉的面孔和陌生的面孔。

definition:
v./adj. 扩散，传播，漫射；冗长的
搭配：diffuse light
etymology: dis-(向四面八方) + fus(流淌/倾倒) = 四处流淌扩散
sentence_en: Clouds act to softly diffuse bright sunlight across the open landscape.
sentence_zh: 云层起到柔和漫射开阔景色中强烈阳光的作用。

definition:
v./n. 消化，领会，文摘
搭配：digest food
etymology: di-(分开) + gest(携带/运送) = 体内食物分解消化
sentence_en: It requires time for the human stomach to completely digest heavy meals.
sentence_zh: 人类的胃需要时间来完全消化油腻的正餐。

definition:
adj. 数字的，数码的，手指的
搭配：digital economy
etymology: digit(手指/数字) + al = 数字时代的
sentence_en: The rapid expansion of the digital economy has transformed traditional commerce.
sentence_zh: 数字经济的迅速扩张改变了传统的商业形态。

definition:
n. 尊严，高贵，端庄
搭配：human dignity
etymology: dign(高贵/有价值) + ity = 高贵与尊严
sentence_en: International human rights laws aim to protect the basic dignity of every individual.
sentence_zh: 国际人权法旨在保护每个个人的基本尊严。

definition:
adj. 勤奋的，刻苦的，细致的
搭配：diligent student
etymology: di-(分离/挑拣) + lig(选择/选出) = 精挑细选、勤勉认真
sentence_en: Diligent students who review lecture notes regularly tend to achieve high grades.
sentence_zh: 经常复习课堂笔记的勤奋学生往往能取得高分。

definition:
v. 减少，减小，贬低
搭配：diminish influence
etymology: di-(向下) + min(小) = 使变得越来越小
sentence_en: Natural resource reserves will gradually diminish without strict conservation policies.
sentence_zh: 如果没有严格的保护政策，自然资源储量将逐渐减少。

definition:
n. 二氧化物
搭配：carbon dioxide
etymology: di-(双/二) + oxide(氧化物) = 二氧化物
sentence_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere during the process of photosynthesis.
sentence_zh: 植物在光合作用过程中从大气中吸收二氧化碳。

definition:
adj. 外交的，圆滑的，有策略的
搭配：diplomatic relations
etymology: diploma(文凭/公文) + atic = 外交官凭公文行事的
sentence_en: Nations often rely on diplomatic negotiations to peacefully resolve territorial disputes.
sentence_zh: 国家往往依靠外交谈判来和平解决领土争端。

definition:
n. 姓名地址录，董事会，目录（计算机）
搭配：file directory
etymology: direct(指导/引导) + ory = 提供指引的目录册
sentence_en: Operating systems organize files neatly into specific folder directories.
sentence_zh: 操作系统将文件整齐地组织到特定的文件夹目录中。

definition:
adj. 灾难性的，悲惨的
搭配：disastrous consequences
etymology: dis-(不吉利) + astr(星星) = 星象不好带来的灾难
sentence_en: Ignoring early safety warnings led to disastrous consequences for the project.
sentence_zh: 忽视早期的安全警告给该项目带来了灾难性的后果。

definition:
v. 识别，看出，察觉出
搭配：discern the pattern
etymology: dis-(分开) + cern(筛分/区分) = 仔细分辨辨别
sentence_en: With powerful telescopes, astronomers can discern faint starlight from distant galaxies.
sentence_zh: 借助强大的望远镜，天文学家可以辨别出来自遥远星系的微弱星光。

definition:
v./n. 释放，排放，解雇，履行（职责）
搭配：discharge waste
etymology: dis-(解除) + charge(负担/装载) = 卸下负担或排放废弃物
sentence_en: Industrial plants are legally banned from discharging untreated chemical waste into rivers.
sentence_zh: 法律禁止工厂将未经处理的化学废物排放到河流中。

definition:
n./v. 纪律，学科，惩罚，训练
搭配：academic discipline
etymology: discip(学生/信徒) + line = 接受管教和训练的规矩
sentence_en: Modern scientific research frequently crosses boundaries between different academic disciplines.
sentence_zh: 现代科学研究经常跨越不同学术学科之间的界限。

definition:
v. 披露，揭露，公开
搭配：disclose information
etymology: dis-(打开/相反) + close(关闭) = 把关闭的门打开、揭露真相
sentence_en: Financial institutions are legally required to disclose transactions transparently.
sentence_zh: 金融机构被法律要求透明地披露交易信息。

definition:
n./v. 折扣，打折，不予考虑
搭配：give a discount
etymology: dis-(向下) + count(计算) = 从总价中扣除计算折扣
sentence_en: Online stores often offer special seasonal discounts to attract festive shoppers.
sentence_zh: 网上商店经常提供特殊的季节性折扣来吸引节日购物者。

definition:
n./v. 演讲，对话，学术论述
搭配：academic discourse
etymology: dis-(到处) + cours(跑动) = 言论到处流传交谈
sentence_en: Universities foster open intellectual discourse and debate among students.
sentence_zh: 大学促进学生之间开放的学术论述与辩论。

definition:
adj. 谨慎的，言行审慎的，不显眼的
搭配：discreet inquiry
etymology: dis-(分离) + cret(区分) = 能明辨是非、谨慎小心的
sentence_en: Secret service agents maintained a discreet presence throughout the state banquet.
sentence_zh: 特勤局特工在国宴期间保持了不显眼的低调警戒。

definition:
n. 谨慎，斟酌处置权，自作主张
搭配：use your discretion
etymology: discreet的名词形式 = 谨慎与自由裁量权
sentence_en: Managers are granted full professional discretion in handling staff scheduling issues.
sentence_zh: 经理们在处理员工排班问题时被授予充分的职业斟酌处置权。

definition:
v. 歧视，区别对待，辨别
搭配：discriminate between
etymology: dis-(分开) + crimin(罪名/界限) = 划清界限并加以区别
sentence_en: Modern workplace regulations strictly prohibit employers from discriminating against applicants.
sentence_zh: 现代职场法规严格禁止雇主对求职者进行歧视。

definition:
v./n. 伪装，掩饰，化装
搭配：disguise one's identity
etymology: dis-(相反) + guise(外表/装扮) = 改变外表进行伪装
sentence_en: The undercover agent wore a clever disguise to hide his true identity.
sentence_zh: 卧底特工进行了巧妙的伪装以隐瞒其真实身份。

definition:
n./v. 厌恶，憎恶，使作呕
搭配：feel disgust
etymology: dis-(相反) + gust(味觉/口味) = 口味不合、感到恶心厌恶
sentence_en: Citizens expressed deep disgust regarding widespread political corruption scandals.
sentence_zh: 公民们对普遍存在的政治腐败丑闻表示极度的厌恶。

definition:
v. 拆除，拆开，废除（机构等）
搭配：dismantle machinery
etymology: dis-(去除) + mantle(斗篷/覆盖物) = 剥去外衣并拆卸部件
sentence_en: Technicians had to carefully dismantle the massive industrial printing machine.
sentence_zh: 技术人员必须小心翼翼地拆卸这台庞大的工业印刷机。

definition:
v. 解散，解雇，驳回，不予理会
搭配：dismiss a case
etymology: dis-(向四处) + miss(送) = 四处遣散开
sentence_en: The judge decided to dismiss the lawsuit due to an absolute lack of solid evidence.
sentence_zh: 由于绝对缺乏确凿证据，法官决定驳回这起诉讼。

definition:
n. 混乱，骚乱，失调（疾病）
搭配：sleep disorder
etymology: dis-(不) + order(秩序) = 没有秩序，即混乱失调
sentence_en: Chronic stress and anxiety can often trigger severe sleep disorders.
sentence_zh: 长期的压力和焦虑往往会引发严重的睡眠失调。

definition:
v. 分散，驱散，散开
搭配：disperse crowds
etymology: dis-(向四处) + spers(撒) = 四处播撒驱散
sentence_en: Police officers used loudspeakers to urge the protesting crowds to disperse peacefully.
sentence_zh: 警察通过扩音器敦促抗议人群和平散开。

definition:
v./n. 陈列，展览，显示
搭配：display artwork
etymology: dis-(展开) + play(折叠的相反) = 展开并展现出来
sentence_en: Museums proudly display ancient artifacts discovered during regional archaeological excavations.
sentence_zh: 博物馆自豪地陈列着在区域考古发掘中发现的古代文物。

definition:
n. 清除，处理，处置
搭配：waste disposal
etymology: dispose(处理/安排)的名词形式 = 处理处置
sentence_en: Modern cities require strict protocols for hazardous chemical waste disposal.
sentence_zh: 现代城市需要对有害化学废物处理制定严格的规程。

definition:
n./v. 争论，争端，对……提出质疑
搭配：territorial dispute
etymology: dis-(相反) + put(计算/思考) = 彼此意见相左产生争执
sentence_en: Neighboring countries engaged in long-standing diplomatic negotiations over a territorial dispute.
sentence_zh: 邻国就领土争端进行了长期的外交谈判。

definition:
v. 溶解，解散，消除
搭配：dissolve in water
etymology: dis-(分开) + solv(松开/解开) = 颗粒松开溶于液体中
sentence_en: Sugar crystals dissolve rapidly when stirred into a warm glass of water.
sentence_zh: 当把糖晶体搅拌进温水玻璃杯时，它们会迅速溶解。

definition:
adj. 清晰的，截然不同的，明显的
搭配：distinct advantage
etymology: dis-(分开) + stinct(刺/标记) = 有清晰界限、截然不同的
sentence_en: Each biological species possesses distinct genetic characteristics.
sentence_zh: 每个生物物种都拥有截然不同的遗传特征。

definition:
n. 差别，区分，优秀，殊荣
搭配：make a distinction
etymology: distinct的名词形式 = 区分与优秀荣誉
sentence_en: It is vital to draw a clear distinction between correlation and causation.
sentence_zh: 划清相关性与因果关系之间的明确区别至关重要。

definition:
v. 区分，辨别，使杰出
搭配：distinguish between
etymology: distinct的动词衍生 = 加以辨别区分
sentence_en: Young children gradually learn to distinguish colors and shapes accurately.
sentence_zh: 小孩子逐渐学会准确地区分颜色和形状。

definition:
v. 扭曲，歪曲（事实、声音等）
搭配：distort facts
etymology: dis-(加强) + stort(扭曲) = 彻底扭曲变形
sentence_en: Unreliable media reports can sometimes distort the objective truth of events.
sentence_zh: 不可靠的媒体报道有时会歪曲事件的客观真相。

definition:
v. 分发，分配，散布
搭配：distribute materials
etymology: dis-(向四处) + tribut(给予) = 四处发放物资
sentence_en: Volunteers worked hard to distribute emergency food supplies to flood victims.
sentence_zh: 志愿者们努力将紧急食品供应分发给洪水受灾群众。

definition:
n. 行政区，区域，地区
搭配：business district
etymology: dis- + strict(严格管辖) = 划定管辖的行政区域
sentence_en: Downtown commercial districts experience heavy pedestrian traffic daily.
sentence_zh: 市中心商业区每天都有密集的步行客流量。

definition:
v. 打扰，妨碍，使不安
搭配：do not disturb
etymology: dis-(加强) + turb(骚动/搅拌) = 把平静搅乱打扰
sentence_en: Please turn off your mobile phones so as not to disturb the conference attendees.
sentence_zh: 请关闭手机，以免打扰会议参加者。

definition:
adj. 多样的，不同的，多元的
搭配：diverse cultures
etymology: di-(分离) + vers(转) = 朝不同方向转、呈现多样性
sentence_en: Universities celebrate a vibrant community composed of students from diverse backgrounds.
sentence_zh: 大学庆祝由来自多元背景的学生组成的充满活力的社区。

definition:
v. 转移（注意力、资金等），使改道
搭配：divert traffic
etymology: di-(偏离) + vert(转) = 转向另一个方向
sentence_en: Road maintenance crews had to divert highway traffic around the accident zone.
sentence_zh: 道路维修人员不得不将高速公路交通从事故地段引导改道。

definition:
adj./v. 神的，神圣的；推测，预言
搭配：divine intervention
etymology: divin(神/上帝) = 神圣的
sentence_en: Ancient civilizations often attributed natural weather catastrophes to divine will.
sentence_zh: 古代文明经常将自然天气灾难归咎于神的意志。

definition:
n./v. 文件，公文；用文件记载/证明
搭配：historical document
etymology: docu(教导/证明) + ment = 可以作为凭证的文件
sentence_en: Archivists carefully preserve fragile historical documents inside climate-controlled vaults.
sentence_zh: 档案馆员将脆弱的历史文件小心翼翼地保存在温控保险库中。

definition:
n. 领域，领土，域名（计算机）
搭配：public domain
etymology: domin(统治/主人) = 领主统治的范围领域
sentence_en: Artificial intelligence research has expanded rapidly into the domain of healthcare.
sentence_zh: 人工智能研究已经迅速扩展到医疗保健领域。

definition:
adj. 国内的，家庭的，驯养的
搭配：domestic market
etymology: dom(家/屋子) + estic = 与家庭或国内事务相关的
sentence_en: Strong domestic consumer spending helped stabilize the national economy during recession.
sentence_zh: 强劲的国内消费者支出有助于在经济衰退期间稳定国民经济。

definition:
adj. 占优势的，支配的，显性的
搭配：dominant position
etymology: domin(统治) + ant = 占统治地位的
sentence_en: Technology giants maintain a dominant position in the global software market.
sentence_zh: 科技巨头在全球软件市场保持着占优势的地位。

definition:
v. 支配，统治，主导，俯视
搭配：dominate the market
etymology: domin(统治) + ate = 居高临下进行支配
sentence_en: A few massive multinational corporations tend to dominate global industrial trade.
sentence_zh: 少数几家庞大的跨国公司往往主导着全球工业贸易。

definition:
v. 捐赠，赠送（金钱、器官等）
搭配：donate blood
etymology: don(给/礼物) + ate = 给予慈善捐赠
sentence_en: Generous philantropists regularly donate funds to support public medical research.
sentence_zh: 慷慨的慈善家定期捐赠资金以支持公共医学研究。

definition:
adj. 休眠的，静止的，隐匿的
搭配：dormant volcano
etymology: dorm(睡觉) + ant = 像在睡觉一样处于休眠状态
sentence_en: Geologists monitor seismic activity around potentially dangerous dormant volcanoes.
sentence_zh: 地质学家监测潜在危险休眠火山周围的地震活动。

definition:
adj. 戏剧性的，急剧的，引人注目的
搭配：dramatic change
etymology: drama(戏剧) + tic = 像戏剧般扣人心弦、急剧变化的
sentence_en: Global industrialization has caused a dramatic increase in atmospheric carbon levels.
sentence_zh: 全球工业化导致大气碳水平出现急剧增加。

definition:
n. 缺点，不利条件，障碍
搭配：major drawback
etymology: draw(拉) + back(向后) = 把优势往后拉的缺点
sentence_en: High production costs remain the primary drawback of this green technology.
sentence_zh: 高昂的生产成本仍然是这项绿色技术的主要缺点。

definition:
n./v. 惧怕，担忧，恐怖
搭配：fear and dread
etymology: dread(极度害怕)
sentence_en: Many students feel a deep sense of dread before facing difficult final examinations.
sentence_zh: 许多学生在面对困难的期末考试前都会感到深深的恐惧与担忧。

definition:
adj. 极端的，激烈的（重现强化记忆）
搭配：drastic reform
etymology: drastic = 强烈激进的
sentence_en: The university enacted drastic academic policy reforms to improve graduate standards.
sentence_zh: 该大学颁布了激进的学术政策改革以提高毕业生标准。

definition:
adj. 昏昏欲睡的，瞌睡的
搭配：feeling drowsy
etymology: drowze(打瞌睡) + y = 困倦的
sentence_en: Heavy afternoon meals often make office workers feel drowsy during meetings.
sentence_zh: 丰盛的午餐常常让上班族在开会时感到昏昏欲睡。

definition:
adj. 怀疑的，可疑的，不确定的
搭配：dubious claim
etymology: dub(两难/犹豫) + ious = 处于两难怀疑之中的
sentence_en: Independent scientists remained highly dubious regarding the product's miracle medical claims.
sentence_zh: 独立科学家对该产品的神奇医疗主张保持高度怀疑态度。

definition:
adj. 耐用的，持久的
搭配：durable materials
etymology: dur(持续/坚固) + able = 经久耐用的
sentence_en: Outdoor construction equipment requires exceptionally durable materials to withstand weather.
sentence_zh: 户外建筑设备需要极其耐用的材料来抵御恶劣天气。

definition:
n. 持续时间，期间
搭配：for the duration of
etymology: dur(持续) + ation = 持续的时间段
sentence_en: Participants must remain inside the laboratory for the entire duration of the study.
sentence_zh: 参与者必须在整个研究期间一直留在实验室里。

definition:
n./v. 矮子，侏儒；使相形见绌
搭配：dwarf competitors
etymology: dwarf(神话中的侏儒)
sentence_en: Modern massive skyscrapers completely dwarf the surrounding historic buildings.
sentence_zh: 现代宏伟的摩天大楼把周围的历史建筑衬托得相形见绌。

definition:
adj./n. 动态的，充满活力的；动力学
搭配：dynamic system
etymology: dynam(力量/能量) + ic = 充满力量和动态变化的
sentence_en: Software engineering requires adapting continuously to a fast-paced dynamic market.
sentence_zh: 软件工程要求不断适应快节奏的动态市场。

definition:
adj. 渴望的，热切的
搭配：eager to learn
etymology: eager(热心渴望的)
sentence_en: University freshmen arrived on campus eager to explore new academic opportunities.
sentence_zh: 大学新生到达校园，渴望探索新的学术机遇。

definition:
adv. 认真地，诚恳地，热切地
搭配：earnestly discuss
etymology: earnest(认真的) + ly = 诚恳认真地
sentence_en: Committee members sat together to earnestly discuss the proposed financial budget.
